runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W4W5W) Sat midfield, raced very wide, minor response when asked (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W4W5W) 居中間位置，走大外疊。對催策略有反應。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, faded top of the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路初力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Tracked pace, unable to quicken 400m out, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處未能加速。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Led, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 領先，其後直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure to hold position 700m out, bumped and lost balance 250m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。七百米處在催策下保持位置。二百五十米處與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace, three wide throughout, one paced under pressure final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，沿途走第三疊。最後三百米在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W4W) Average to begin, raced in midfield on the inside, angled out 550M, no daylight early in straight, cleared approaching 200M, finished off well to be nearest on line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W4W) 出閘一般，居中間位置，走內疊。五百五十米處向外移出。直路初未能望空。趨近二百米處時望空。衝刺良佳，過終點時最為接近。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W4W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, raced keenly, made some ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。搶口。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W2W) Sat worse than midfield, traveled smoothly, responded fairly well when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走勢暢順。對催策反應不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Tracked pace, chased leaders from top of home straight, stayed on well, gradually closing down winner final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。自直路初起追趕領先馬匹。保持佳勢，最後一百米逐漸追近頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, stayed on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Switched off to race at the rear of the field over 10Ls back middle stages, steadied 300M when commencing to finish off the race, had to change lane but the final effort was just fair.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 留居後列。中段落後逾十個馬位。三百米處在開始衝刺之際收慢。末段須轉換跑線，但衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, raced keenly in the early and middle stages, no clear run until 200M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置，早段及中段搶口。未能望空直至二百米處，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced better than midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after passing 350M, hit the front 200M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。跑過三百五十米處後向外移出。二百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked pace, ridden and made effort 400m out, no extra and lost ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。受催策，四百米處發力。最後二百米再無餘力，失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the outside, slightly improved after passing 600M, 2nd turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。跑過六百米處後略為推進。入直路時居第二位。直路初保持佳勢。一百米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, challenged by rival turning in, headed 250M, kept on well until approaching 50M, weakened gradually close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前領放。入直路時受對手挑戰。二百五十米處被超越，保持佳勢直至趨近五十米處。接近終點時逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced prominently, 2 wide, challenged the leader 600M, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居前列，走第二疊。六百米處挑戰領放馬。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, failed to respond under whip (See Incident Report).
(Blood at the right nostril.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。對鞭策毫無反應。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右邊鼻孔有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat handy, one pace to the line (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。保持同速至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat outside the leader, nothing in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W1W1W) Made running, challenged 700m out, remained in share of lead until 400m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W1W1W) 領放。七百米處受挑戰。四百米處前仍並排領先。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Tracked leaders three wide, keen, effort over 300m out, faded final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊，搶口。三百米處發力。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, headed approaching 700M, retook the lead 500M, kept on very well in straight and won by a length. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。趨近七百米處時被超越。五百米處再度取得領先。直路上保持甚佳走勢，以一個馬位之先掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W3W6W6W) Dropped out from wide draw, commenced move out wide 900m out, unable to improve position, left behind in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W3W6W6W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。九百米處開始上前，走外疊。未能推進，直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W) Began well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, peaked 200M, weakened final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。二百米處未能再增速。最後五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (2W3W) Jumped well, took the early lead, headed 1350M, 2nd in the middle stages, 3 wide turning in, kept on well in straight but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘迅速，早段取得領先。一千三百五十米處被超越。中段居第二位。入直路時走第三疊。直路上保持佳勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Began well from gate 9, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, peaked and headed 200M, kept on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 自第九檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。二百米處未能再增速，被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Pushed along to be racing closely behind leaders, couldn't sustain run passing 350M, weakened towards the finish. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 受推策，緊隨領先馬匹。跑過三百五十米處時後勁不繼。末段轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, enjoyed the easy lead to turn, peaked and headed 200M, stayed on evenly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前輕鬆領放。二百米處未能再增速及被超越。末段保持穩勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Chased leader after jumping from draw 13, briefly led early straight but soon couldn't keep up with pursuing rivals, faded to finish 6th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔躍出後追趕領放馬。直路早段一度領先，但瞬即未能抗衡緊追的對手。力竭，取得第六名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon led from a poor draw, gradually shifted across for rails run over 1200M out, led until joined early in home straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即領放。千二米處逐漸切入內欄。領先至直路初被追及。最後一百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, ridden over 200m out, closed down final 100m, headed on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。二百米處受催策。最後一百米被追近。過終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W3W5W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, last turning in, failed to make any progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W3W5W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時居包尾位置。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W6W) Ridden along from a wide draw, gradually shifted backward to midfield onto first bend remaining wide without cover, yielded ground noticeably from over 500M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W6W) 自外檔出閘後受催策。開始轉首個彎位時逐漸墮居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處起顯著墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide better than midfield early, steadied near 1050M, 2 wide in midfield on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近一千零五十米處時收慢。直路彎居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slightly slow out and made contact, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘稍慢，被觸碰。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Crowded leaving stalls, raced in last pair, hung left bend and struggling into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時受擠迫，居最後兩位。直路彎外閃，入直路時掙扎上前，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Held up last after bumped heavily out of stalls and lost balance, ridden along 400m out but detached, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;躍出時與對手互相大力碰撞，失去平衡，其後留後。四百米處受催策，但被拋離。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, peaked early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。直路早段未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Wide in mid-field, under pressure 500m out, soon lost place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走外疊。五百米處受催策。瞬即失位。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W5W) Mid-field, raced wide, forced wider final bend, soon lost place and well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W5W) 居中間位置，走外疊。直路彎被迫走更外疊。瞬即失位，所負頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W4W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, crowded top of the Straight, gave ground thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W4W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路初受擠迫，其後墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W2W3W5W) Sat handy, angled out rounding the Turn, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W2W3W5W) 居前列。轉直路彎時向外移出。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) In touch with leaders, ridden to hold position from halfway, soon weakened home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。自半程起受催策以保持位置。直路上瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (4W3W3W4W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 3 wide with no cover behind midfield, moved closer after passing 900M, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(4W3W3W4W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。跑過九百米處後追近。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W4W) Held up last after slowly away, pushed along widest into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W4W) 出閘緩慢，其後留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, guided to the fence racing in second half of the field, had 5Ls to make up top of the straight and never looked likely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。移入內欄，居後半馬群中。直路初落後五個馬位，從未見具爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled rear on the rail, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙。居後列，走內欄。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Slow to begin, ended up racing in last over 10Ls off the pace, in similar position making the home turn before running past a few beaten horses in the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，居包尾位置，落後領放馬逾十個馬位。轉直路彎時居相若位置。直路上超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Slowly away, held up, no impression when ridden along home straight.
(Lost right front plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，留後。直路上在催策下毫無表現。
（失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W1W1W) Taken back to race at tail, 8 lengths or so back turning in, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時落後約八個馬位，轉入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Slightly slow out, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, peaked on run 200M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百米處未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the outside, commenced move 500M, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。五百米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Sat in front of midfield, minor progress made when asked (See incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間之前位置。在催策下略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Sat off pace 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W4W) Raced in touch with leaders, wide into home straight, kept going but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹。入直路時走外疊。保持走勢，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W2W3W) Sat just behind the leaders, travelled nicely at the top of the Straight, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初走勢良佳，在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat midfield, traveled reasonably well, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢不俗。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Stumbled leaving stalls then squeezed out, good headway up inside rail over 300m out, unable to sustain and lost ground final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘時失蹄，其後受擠迫。三百米處沿欄追前甚多。最後一百米後繼無力及失地。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat worse than midfield, closed off fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。末段衝刺一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made minor headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 4Ls back, there to turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent early, gradually shifted back to worse than midfield in 9th, inconvenienced when tempo slackened 800M out, baulked until clear run 300M out near the centre of the track, ran on steadily to be nearest at finish
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 早段居前列，逐漸墮居中間之後的第九位。八百米處在步速減慢時受妨礙。受困直至三百米處望空，靠近跑道中央競跑。末段以穩勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; Out with rest, raced behind midfield, nearer to the middle track, 4 lengths back in the middle stages, made no progress final 400M.
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，靠近跑道中央競跑。中段落後四個馬位。最後四百米毫無進展。
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled midfield one off the fence, one paced to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Sat behind midfield 2 wide, made no impression. (See Incident Report)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。毫無表現。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Sat last on the rail, stayed on late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置，走內欄。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, sat worse than midfield, traveled smoothly, responded nicely when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。走勢暢順。對催策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, unable to obtain clear run until approaching final 150M, made minor progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。未能望空直至趨近一百五十米處。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W4W5W) Jumped only fairly, sat rear, commenced to improve near the 500M, made minor progress when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W4W5W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列。接近五百米處時開始推進。在催策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W5W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide on bend, strong run final 200m to close on winner, just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W5W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎受推策，走外疊。最後二百米走勢強勁，追近頭馬，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced behind midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back turning in, unable to obtain clear run until approaching final 100M, finished off strongly to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般及被觸碰，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後三個馬位，未能望空直至趨近最後一百米。衝刺強勁，取得亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W2W1W) Jumped with them, raced at rear throughout, never a factor. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W2W1W) 與對手同步出閘，沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, failed to close off in straight.
Substantial blood.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上衝刺乏力。
氣管內有很多血。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Towards rear, pushed along final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居後列。直路彎受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W2W1W1W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 800m out, forced to steady 200m out, never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W2W1W1W2W) 居中間之後位置。八百米處受催策。二百米處被迫收慢。從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 出閘一般，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Held up last from wide draw, late headway into mid-division, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居包尾位置。末段追前至中間位置。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W1W1W) Sat rear, not much response when asked, no contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W1W1W) 居後列。對催策反應不大。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, angled out 400M, very wide turning in, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，發生觸碰。居中間之後位置，走第二疊。四百米處向外移出。入直路時走大外疊。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Three wide in rear, pushed along wide in home straight, forced to steady 250m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上受推策，走外疊。二百五十米處被迫收慢。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Mid-field, stayed on for pressure final 200m but lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W3W4W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, moved a bit closer after passing 1100M, 3 lengths back on turn, very wide into straight, made no impression in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W3W4W) 自大外檔出閘後留居後列，走外疊。跑過千一米處後略為追近，直路彎落後三個馬位。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W3W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide behind midfield, very wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Waited with towards rear, under pressure 700m out, switched widest in home straight, some late gains.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策。直路上移至最外疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and finished off strongly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊。衝刺強勁，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W2W4W) Slowly away, taken back to race at tail, very wide turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘緩慢，留居包尾位置。入直路時走大外疊。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced at rear on the outside, very wide turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Slowly away and lost four lengths, always well in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘緩慢，落後四個馬位。全程遙居於後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W2W2W3W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, angled out 1100M, slightly improved in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W2W2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。千一米處向外移出，中段略為推進。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位，直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W2W4W) Crowded and bumped at start, rail position in mid-field, angled out to make run 450m out, ran on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W2W4W) 起步時受擠迫及發生碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。四百五十米處向外移出推進。末段保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, responded well under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居前列。走勢良佳。末段對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Tracked the leader, slightly weakened entering the Straight, kept on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬。入直路時略為轉弱。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, had every chance in the Straight, unable to go pass the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但未能超越頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, driven along 450m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段追趕領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。四百五十米處受催策。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from gate 1, sent forward to take the lead, travelled comfortably to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢暢順。直路上保持佳勢，但最後一百米不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-1/4L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 150M, weakened gradually close home, just stayed on to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前，取得領先。入直路時領先一又四分一個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速，被超越。接近終點時逐漸轉弱，僅能保持走勢，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted out at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, found rail near 650M, 1-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
Lost right front plate.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百五十米處時移入內欄。入直路時落後一個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，掄元。
失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, driven along 700m out, soon well held, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。七百米處受催策，瞬即遙遙落後。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well from a poor draw but soon taken back to last few, remained in rear into straight, ran on past well-beaten horses in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時仍居後列。末段追前，超越已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, rail position, chased leaders off bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W4W) In rear after stumbled leaving stalls, pushed along widest into home straight, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W4W) 出閘時失蹄，居後列。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Began well, raced 2 wide in midfield, 4 lengths or so back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路早段未能再加速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced prominently on the inside, allowed rival to cross near 900M, sat right behind the leader on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居前列，走內疊。接近九百米處時讓對手過頭。直路彎緊隨領放馬。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, struggled to maintain position from 600m out, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自六百米處起難以保持位置，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Tracked leading pair, ridden to challenge 300m out, tended to edge right, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放兩駒。三百米處在催策下展開挑戰，傾向內閃。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled towards the rear 2 wide, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，走第二疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能望空直至三百米處。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Sat on pace on the rail, gave ground final 200M. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 2 wide, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W3W4W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, very wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊。直路初對催策反應平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 3 wide in midfield, carried wider turning in, showed no response early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出更外疊。直路早段對催策毫無反應，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W2W) Settled midfield 2 wide, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Broke well from a wide barrier and soon taken back to last few, became last on straightening despite saving ground on rail, soon detached.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留居最後數位之內。入直路時雖走內欄節省腳程，但居包尾位置。瞬即被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W) Taken back from wide draw, last and pushed along into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時居包尾位置，受推策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Held up last, ridden along middle stages to catch up to main body, eased once well held in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 留居包尾位置。中段受催策以追上主馬群。直路上遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced behind the leader on the inside, peaked on turn, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相碰撞，居領放馬之後，走內疊。直路彎未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Led, headed halfway, remained prominent, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 領放。半程時被超越。保持居前列。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Away with them, positioned a length behind the leader, 2 wide, there to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後領放馬一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前頗多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled well back from the widest barrier, ran on steadily down the centre of the track inside final 300M to reach 4th late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 自最外檔出閘，遙居於後。最後三百米在跑道中央以穩勢上前，末段取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Mid-field, tight for room briefly 250m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。二百五十米處一度受緊迫。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, driven along 550m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處受催策，未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W1W2W) Held up in last pair after hampered early, still well back entering home straight, looked green, little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W1W2W) 早段受阻礙，其後留居最後兩位之內。入直路時仍遙居於後。看來走勢稚嫩，無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide better than midfield, 2-1/2L back turning in, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般。居中間之前位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped only fairly, trapped 4 wide, slightly better than midfield, showed some response early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍前位置，走第四疊。直路早段對催策略有反應。一百五十米處未能再增速，其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped on terms, settled just off the pace, had every chance from 400M, run ended mid-straight and weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居領放馬稍後的位置。自四百米處起一度甚具爭勝機會。直路中段無以為繼，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Crowded on jumping, sat towards rear, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 躍出時受擠迫，居後列。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Raced very wide throughout, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 沿途走大外疊。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, moved a little bit closer on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen early, quickly lost place turning into home straight, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊，早段搶口。入直路時迅速失位，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced at rear, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後約五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑入季席，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W6W) Began awkwardly, raced towards rear on the outside, 6 to 7 lengths back turning in, made very good progress in straight to score. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W6W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後六至七個馬位。直路上追前甚多，掄元。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Awkward start, three wide in mid-field without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Sat handy, raced wide, gave ground quickly near 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走外疊。接近三百米處時迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled within 3L of pace in 5th, commenced move entering straight but faded under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居第五位，落後領放馬不逾三個馬位。入直路時開始上前，但最後三百米在催策下力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Began awkwardly and sat prominent outside the leader, overraced in the early stages, failed to sustain his run and compounded rapidly at the straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居領放馬外側位置。早段搶口。後勁不繼。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Jumped awkwardly, settled handy, lay in in the Straight, failed to respond.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘笨拙，居前列。直路上內閃。對催策毫無反應。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slow to jump, sat towards rear on the inside, minor progress made in the Straight. (Blood in mouth.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。走內疊。直路上略為追前。（口內有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Slowly away, rail position in rear of mid-field, pushed along 700m out, never involved, eased 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。七百米處受推策。從未參與競逐。二百米處收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat last, picked off a few weakened rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已轉弱的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) In rear, unable to quicken under pressure 300m out, one paced and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。三百米處在催策下未能加速。保持同速，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Slowly away, recovered but towards rear. Pushed along 300m out, no real impression, ran out of room final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後恢復走勢，但居後列。三百米處受推策。無甚表現。最後五十米空位不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W) Average to begin, settled at the rear, steadied 50m out, failed to run on final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W) 起步普通，居後列。五十米處收慢。末段未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled okay, slightly weakened over the concluding stages, ran on evenly (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 在催策下領放。走勢不俗。末段略為轉弱，保持穩勢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Away well, raced in midfield on the outside, 3-1/2Ls back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後三個半馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Sat towards rear, failed to respond when asked, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居後列。對催策毫無反應。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W1W1W) Away with them, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W1W1W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back turning in, no clear run early in straight, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘後留後，落後約五個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時落後相同距離。直路早段未能望空，保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W2W3W) Drawn wide, held up last, pushed along from top of home straight, stayed on down the outside, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W2W3W) 自大外檔出閘，留居包尾位置。自直路初起受推策。在外疊保持走勢。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in last few, made up good ground in home straight to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居最後數位之內。直路上追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W) Sat towards rear, no clear run in early Straight until 200M, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列。直路早段未能望空直至二百米處。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Began smartly, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground throughout, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。沿途走內疊節省腳程。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W3W) Settled midfield on the rail, made steady ground in the straight but had to check at the 150M, not tested thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路上穩步上前，但一百五十米處須勒避。其後未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat midfield, made some progress under whip, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間位置。在鞭策下略為追前。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Mid-field, once paced under pressure, late gains but never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。在催策下保持同速。末段追前，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W3W) Bumped on jumping, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 400M, 4 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W3W) 躍出時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。入直路時落後四個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Shifted out at start, raced 3 wide better than midfield early, 2 wide on turn, took the lead 250M, peaked and headed approaching 200M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時向外斜跑，早段居中間之前位置，走第三疊。直路彎走第二疊。二百五十米處取得領先。趨近二百米處時未能再增速，被超越。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Sat handy, traveled fairly, could not be ridden out when positioned close to heels.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居前列，走勢一般。末段在靠近他駒的後蹄時未能被力策。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Made contact shortly after start, tracked leaders, 2 wide, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久與他駒互相觸碰，跟隨領先馬匹，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W1W1W) Showed good speed to across, headed 250m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，切入內疊。二百五十米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (5W2W2W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced prominently on the outside, peaked on run near 400M, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Lame in right front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(5W2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居前列，走外疊。接近四百米處時未能再增速。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（右前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Made contact at start, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, headed by rivals 100m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。四百米處加速。一百米處被對手超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide slightly better than midfield, difficult to settle throughout, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第二疊。沿途難以穩定走勢。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Taken back to race 2 wide behind midfield, angled out approaching 350M, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居中間之後位置，走第二疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Jumped well from a wide draw, raced slightly better than midfield on outer, no cover throughout, 3 lengths or so back turning in, kept on same pace in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Sat in front of midfield, weakened passing 250M, gave ground quickly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 居中間之前位置。跑過二百五十米處時轉弱，迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, hung out in the Home Straight, failed to run out (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上外閃，未能追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide better than midfield, bumped near 600M, 2-1/2L back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時發生碰撞。入直路時落後兩個半馬位。以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced 2 wide towards rear, angled out and made contact near 450M, no clear run until approaching final 100M, made no progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步時向外斜跑及與對手互相觸碰，居後列，走第二疊。接近四百五十米處時向外移出及發生觸碰。未能望空直至趨近一百米處。其後毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield, 3 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take a place without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲季軍，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Missed the start, sat midfield 3 wide, gave ground in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 漏閘，居中間位置，走第三疊。直路上墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began smartly from a wide draw, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但接近終點時不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Bumped start, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1-3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生碰撞，在催策下上前領放。入直路時領先一又四分三馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後五十米未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, took the lead near 150M, kept on well but could not hold off the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。接近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Unbalanced after being bumped at the start. Sent forward to take the lead, travelled strongly, led by 2L turning in and all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 起步時被碰撞，其後失去平衡。受催策上前領放，走勢強勁。入直路時領先二個馬位。一放到底，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Tracked leader, challenged alongside winner from 300m out, unable to get past that rival.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起在頭馬側旁展開挑戰，但未能超越對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Raced at center behind midfield, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置，在跑道中央競跑。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, outpaced and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路初受催策。最後三百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover in the middle stages, peaked on run 500M, weakened gradually in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走外疊。中段沒有遮擋。五百米處未能再增速。直路上逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W4W) Raced very wide throughout in rear of mid-field, some headway on bend, forced to steady 100m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W4W) 居中間之後位置，沿途走大外疊。直路彎略為追前。一百米處被迫收慢，其後未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled handy, traveled smoothly, responded nicely under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居前列，走勢暢順。對鞭策反應良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Blundered at the Start, sat rear, badly held up in the Straight until 100M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 起步時失蹄，居後列。直路上嚴重受困直至一百米處。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Made contact at start and unbalanced, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover in the middle stages, showed good response early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時與對手互相觸碰，失去平衡。居中間之前位置，走第三疊。中段沒有遮擋。直路早段對催策反應良佳。一百五十米處未能再加速。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W4W3W) Moderately away from the widest draw, trapped wide in midfield, moved closer after passing 800M, 2nd on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W4W3W) 自最外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊。跑過八百米處後追近。直路彎居第二位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Rear of mid-field, headway 300m out, unable to sustain and no real impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之後位置。三百米處追前。末段無以為繼，未能構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Bumped start and unbalanced, raced better than midfield on the outside, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 起步時與對手互相碰撞，失去平衡，居中間之前位置，走外疊。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled handy, traveled nicely, kept on well to win.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走勢良佳。保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W) Began well from a poor draw but gradually taken back remaining wide throughout, reached second last into straight, renewed effort inside final 200M producing good late impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但逐漸留後。沿途走外疊。入直路時居尾二位置。最後二百米重新發力。末段追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat on pace 3 wide no cover, ran on strongly, just got caught on the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居前列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。走勢強勁，僅於終點線上被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced towards rear, 5 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘後留居後列，落後約五個馬位。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Moderately away, raced in midfield, 2 to 3 lengths back, hard ridden approaching 300M but only showed limited response, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘普通，居中間位置，落後兩至三個馬位。趨近三百米處時受力策，但反應僅屬平平。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W4W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, some headway 800m out, pushed along widest into home straight, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W4W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。八百米處略為追前。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) In rear after slowly away, still in rear top of home straight, good headway early in home straight, no further impression final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後居後列。直路初仍居後列。直路早段追前甚多。最後二百米再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Began only fairly, taken back to race at rear, 13 lengths back in the middle stages, made very good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居後列。中段落後十三個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began only fairly, raced behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made minor progress early in straight, peaked on run 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。保持穩勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Sat in front of midfield on the outside rail, made ground until checked near 150M, not tested thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居中間之前位置，走外欄。追前，接近一百五十米處時勒避。其後未能施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Settled in 9th spot but less than 3Ls away from leaders, couldn't keep up final 250M and dropped out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;居第九位，但落後領先馬匹不足三個馬位。最後二百五十米未能跟上，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Bumped out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, switched towards centre of course 400m out, bumped 300m out, tight for room 150m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處移向跑道中央。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。一百五十米處受緊迫。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in last few of bunched field, crowded 600M out dropping to second last rounding home bend, made up ground in straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居馬群最後數位之內。六百米處受擠迫。轉直路彎時墮居尾二位置。直路上追前。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Settled in rear of mid-field, challenged and every chance from 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;居中間之後位置。自三百米處起展開挑戰，一度極具爭勝機會，但未能增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Slightly slow out, raced towards rear, hard ridden after passing 250M, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a narrow margin. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘稍慢，居後列。跑過二百五十米處後受力策。衝刺強勁，跑獲亞軍，僅以短距離之差見負。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Crowded shortly after the start and was taken across behind runners to race near the stand side, held up for clear running 300M-200M before closing off the race moderately.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;起步後不久受擠迫，在馬群之後切入，靠近外欄競跑。三百米處至二百米處之間受困而未能望空，其後衝刺普通。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered to rear of midfield on rail after slow start, one-paced from a similar position into home straight before faded inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，其後瞬即恢復走勢，居中間之後位置，走內欄。入直路時居相若位置，保持同速。最後二百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Jumped well from the widest draw, raced better than midfield on outer, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自大外檔出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, detached from 500m out, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。自五百米處起被拋離。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Sat last, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, struggled to hold position final bend, outpaced and left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎難以保持位置。最後二百米未能跟上步速，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden top of home straight, headed 150m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。直路初受催策。一百五十米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Began smartly, raced slightly better than midfield on the inside early, dropped to midfield in the middle stages, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Airway abnormality (dorsal displacement of the soft palate).)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Airway abnormality (dorsal displacement of the soft palate).)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間稍前位置，走內疊。中段墮居中間位置。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）
（呼吸道出現異常情況（軟顎上移）。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （呼吸道出現異常情況（軟顎上移）。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W) Ridden to the front briefly before taken over 2L back to 3rd 900M out, became 4th some 4L back 600M out, kept on early in straight before swamped inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W) 受催策，一度帶頭，其後留後逾兩個馬位，九百米處居第三位。六百米處居第四位，落後約四個馬位。直路初保持同速。最後一百米被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W5W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W5W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Sat outside the lead 2 wide, one pace when asked. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側，走第二疊。在催策下保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in touch with leaders against rail, unable to secure clear run until 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Average to begin, positioned 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back, wider turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，落後約三個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W2W) Pressed forward around first bend to join leaders 3-wide, obtained 2-wide position 800M out, faded steadily out of contention after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W2W) 受催策上前。首次轉彎時追上領先馬匹，走第三疊。八百米處走第二疊。入直路後逐漸力竭，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Away with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, wider turning in, kept on same pace in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走較外疊。直路上保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on until weakened in the final strides. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持走勢，直至最後數步轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (5W4W) Tracked pace three wide, keen, brief effort early in home straight, soon weakened.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(5W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走第三疊。搶口。直路早段一度發力，瞬即轉弱。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 5 lengths back turning in, no daylight early in straight, made good progress final 200M to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路初未能望空。最後二百米追前頗多，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W) Settled on the rail behind the pacemaker, saved ground to turn, kept on one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。直路彎前走內欄節省腳程。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) From draw 11, raced wide without cover for the majority of race.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自第十一檔出閘，大部分途程在沒有遮擋下走外疊。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W2W) Tracked leaders, ridden on bend to chase leaders, well placed into home straight, flattened out final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。直路彎受催策以追趕領先馬匹。入直路時居好位。最後一百五十米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide better than midfield, there to turn, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, weakened quickly final 300m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受催策。最後三百米迅速轉弱，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W) Tracked leader against rail, driven along to chase leader 450m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百五十米處受催策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/4L turning in, peaked and headed 250M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前領放。入直路時領先四分一個馬位。二百五十米處未能再增速，被超越，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W) Began well from a wide draw, raced in 2nd, a length back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居第二位。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路初未能再增速。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled 3-wide in rear of midfield early stages, made short-lived headway past the 900M, ran home one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段居中間之後位置，走第三疊。跑過九百米處時一度追前。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W2W) Never far off, travelled keenly in 3rd behind leader on rail, angled out for a run into home straight, ran on to hold every chance only to be outsprinted inside final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W2W) 從未遠離領放馬，居領放馬之後的第三位，走內欄，搶口。入直路時向外移出取位。末段追前，一度甚具爭勝機會，僅於最後五十米告不敵。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) From a wide draw taken back to near the rear, no daylight until 250M, ran on strongly just missed by a short head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。末能望空直至二百五十米處。以勁勢上前，僅以短馬頭位落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (5W5W) Very wide throughout from high draw, lost ground on leaders on bend, headway 200m out, flattened out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(5W5W) 自最外檔出閘，沿途走大外疊。直路彎落後領先馬匹。二百米處追前，洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Settled midfield, traveled reasonably well, dropped back quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled midfield 3 wide without cover, hard ridden at the top of the straight but found little and was one-paced to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受力策，但再無餘力，保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Crowded shortly after start, raced behind midfield on outer, 3 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走外疊。轉入直路時落後約三個馬位。直路早段略為追前。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Settled in front of midfield on the rail, no clear room in the Straight, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。直路上未能望空。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped exiting stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along 400m out, passed a few tiring rivals.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;出閘時被碰撞，居中間之後位置。四百米處受推策。超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W3W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled fairly, minor progress made under whip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W3W) 居中間之前位置，走勢一般。末段在鞭策下略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W2W) Mid-field, checked briefly and blundered 400m out, unable to quicken for pressure, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處一度勒避及失蹄。在催策下未能加速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Keen in mid-field, rail position, unable to quicken 300m out, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 中段搶口，走內欄。三百米處未能加速，最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W1W1W2W) Bumped leaving stalls, held up, keen under restraint, forward move 300m out, stayed on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W1W1W2W) 出閘時發生碰撞。受困，在約束下搶口。三百米處上前，保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield the fence, failed to respond given a few reminders over final stages, eased down last 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。末段數度受鞭策，毫無反應，最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Sat on pace, traveled fairly, gave ground passing the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居前列，走勢一般。跑過一百五十米處時墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Waited with towards rear, forced to steady 900m out, effort 400m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處被迫收慢。四百米處發力，但未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W2W) Away well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, peaked on run 250M, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。二百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, ridden along 500m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。五百米處受催策。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Jumped only fairly and raced at the back, struggled to keep up with rivals middle stages, couldn't go on final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘僅屬一般，居後列。中段難以跟上對手。最後四百米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Awkward start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along to chase leaders 400m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步笨拙，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, under pressure 400m out, lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處受催策。速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, peaked and headed approaching 300M, weakened and eased thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前領放。直路彎前走勢良佳。趨近三百米處時未能再增速及被超越，其後轉弱及收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, raced keenly, unable to pick up from pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，搶口。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, sent forward to race prominently, 2 wide, 1/4L back turning in, weakened early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，受催策上前，居前列，走第二疊。入直路時落後四分一個馬位。直路初轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to get across from widest draw to lead, kicked two lengths clear early in home straight, in control final 200m, won comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自最外檔出閘，展現甚快前速，切入領放。直路初帶離兩個馬位。最後二百米控制大局。輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced in midfield on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, no daylight early in straight, ran on evenly to the line. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居中間位置，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路初未能望空。保持穩勢至終點。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Led, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 領放。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Away awkwardly and settled prominent early, overraced early stages, lacked a finishing effort over the final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘笨拙，早段居前列，搶口。末段衝刺乏力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat in front of midfield on the rail, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之前位置，走內欄。對催策反應平平。

formguide.comments_eng: South African ISG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Gimmethegreenlight from Honorine, a daughter of Redoute's Choice. Horses by the same sire include Navas G and Green Laser. The fellow was given three trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat not far behind the pace and finished second under pressure, beaten by a neck, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 12. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh under slight pressure, beaten 6-3/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Gimmethegreenlight之後，在港同父馬包括「星光大道」及「綠登」等駒，生母出自「利得精選」(Redoute's Choice)。抵港後三次試閘一次上名。10月12日出試從化草地1000米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第七名，落後頭馬6.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Super Seth from Irion, a daughter of Danroad. Horses by the same sire include Patch Of Cosmo and Team Team Folks. He was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 2L, over 800m on turf in Conghua on October 5. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished eighth under pressure, beaten by 2-3/4Ls, over 1000m on turf in Conghua on October 23. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「超凡高手」(Super Seth)之後，在港同父馬包括「錶之宇宙」及「天天友福」等駒，生母出自Danroad。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。10月5日出試從化草地800米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1000米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第八名，落後頭馬2.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Crowded at start from a wide barrier settling in last few, obtained clear run over 200M out, produced good late impression to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自外檔起步時受擠迫，居最後數位之內。二百米處望空。末段追前甚多，過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 moved up to track leader, pulled hard during the race, failed to finish the job when asked early in the straight.
Jockey dropped whip 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，上前跟隨領放馬。陣上大力搶口。直路初受催策，但未能以勁勢衝刺。
騎師於一百五十米處跌掉馬鞭。
runnerrecords.incident_chi: 騎師於一百五十米處跌掉馬鞭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Mid-field, had to wait for run in first half of home straight, ran on well once gaps appeared final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置。直路前半段須等待空位出現。最後一百五十米望空後隨即以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W5W) Given a quiet ride in early stages and maintained a midfield position 3-4Ls from leaders, made solid inroads to finish and not far out of the placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W5W) 早段留後競跑，保持中間位置，落後領先馬匹三至四個馬位。末段追前頗多，落後三甲馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) In rear after awkward start, some late headway but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Sat handy, traveled smoothly, ran on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居前列。走勢暢順。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Tracked leaders, switched wide for clear run 600m out, ridden top of home straight, stayed on well but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。六百米處移出外疊以望空。直路初受催策，保持佳勢，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace three wide, perfectly placed to challenge over 300m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走第三疊。三百米處居絕佳位置以展開挑戰，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Sat off pace 2 wide, gave ground final furlong. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 居領放馬之後，走第二疊。最後二百米墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat on pace 2 wide, travelled up smoothly top of the Straight, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。直路初走勢暢順。末段未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) In last few early stages, forced to check 900M out before pulling forward wide around home bend, fought on under pressure from just over 2L back into straight until finding no extra close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 早段居最後數位內。九百米處被迫勒避。轉直路彎時上前，走外疊。入直路時落後稍逾兩個馬位，在催策下力拼，直至接近終點時再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W) Started well from wide draw and across to make running, came under pressure 200m out, challenged by runner-up final 100m, responded and always holding that rival final 50m despite edging left.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W) 自外檔出閘迅速，切入領放。二百米處受催策。最後一百米受亞軍馬匹挑戰。最後五十米雖然向外斜跑，但對催策交出反應，一直力拒該匹對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Bounded as stalls opened and lost ground, caught up to main body of runners 700m out, hung in top of home straight, ran on well final 200m to make up some ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 開閘時向上跳躍及失地。七百米處追上主馬群。直路初內閃。最後二百米走勢良佳，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W2W) Towards rear after sluggish start, under pressure over 300m out, no impression.
(Lame in left hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。三百米處受催策。毫無表現。
（左後腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; On jumping made contact with the left side of its starting gate, raced at tail, still 8 lengths back in the middle stages, made some headway final 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;躍出時觸碰閘廂左側，居包尾位置，中段仍落後八個馬位。最後四百米略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, unable to quickened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W) Settled in front of midfield, raced wide, gave ground quickly in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W) 居中間之前位置，走外疊。直路上迅速墮退。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Pushed on from a wide gate and sat outside the leader, fought on gamely to finish into placings.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自外檔出閘後受推策，居領放馬外側。以佳勢力拼，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Shifted in at start and made contact, raced in midfield on outer, no cover throughout, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 起步時向內斜跑及發生觸碰，居中間位置，走外疊。沿途沒有遮擋。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Sat behind the leaders, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹之後。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Tracked leader, improved to lead 200m out, headed 75m out, no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 跟隨領放馬。上前，二百米處取得領先。七十五米處被超越。再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Checked leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, angled off rail 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘後勒避，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處移離內欄。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Dropped back from draw 13 to race near the rear of the field, fought hard in the final straight but lacked a strong response and was never a real threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自第十三檔出閘，墮居後列。直路上力拼，但對催策反應欠強勁。從未能真正威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Broke well from a middle barrier, struggled to find cover in midfield 4-wide before heading forward inside the 1000M eventually joining race leader approaching home turn, found no extra inside final 200M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 自中檔出閘迅速。難以取得遮擋，居中間位置，走第四疊。一千米處上前，趨近直路彎時追上領放馬。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced slightly behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 600m out, short of room top of home straight, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W) 居中間位置。六百米處受催策。直路初空位不足。最後二百米以佳勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, no clear run until 200M, ran on well afterwards.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能望空直至二百米處，其後以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Mid-field, stayed on well for pressure final 300m, unable to reach winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。最後三百米在催策下保持佳勢，但未能追及頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) In rear, still plenty to do top of home straight, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, stayed on well once clear final 200m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居後列。直路初仍落後甚遠。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百米望空後保持佳勢，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Disputed lead early, tracked leaders after 400m, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 早段爭奪領先。過了首四百米後跟隨領先馬匹。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Soon taken back for rails run, steadily pulled his way forward to just worse than midfield in 10th onto home bend, saved ground turning in for 7th, kept on at the one pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 瞬即留後，走內欄。穩步上前，開始轉直路彎時居中間稍後第十位。入直路時走內欄節省腳程，居第七位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Sat midfield on the rail, made no ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。未能追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, switched to challenge leaders 500m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以挑戰領先馬匹。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Taken back to race 3 wide towards rear, 6 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made no impression in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 留居後列，落後約六個馬位，走第三疊。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W4W4W) Crowded at start, held up last, pushed along widest into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W4W4W) 起步時受擠迫，留居包尾位置。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W3W4W) Towards rear, wide and lost ground final bend, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W3W4W) 居後列。直路彎走外疊及失地。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W2W4W5W) Waited with towards rear, headway widest final bend, strong run to lead over 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W2W4W5W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎上前，走最外疊。衝刺強勁，一百米處取得領先。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear, 6 lengths or so back turning in, passed some tired runners in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W2W) Sat outside the leader, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 居領放馬外側。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W5W) Raced very widest without cover throughout, some headway on bend, lost touch final 300m, left behind.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W5W) 沿途走大外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。最後三百米未能跟上對手，被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled behind midfield 6Ls back, only battled home final 400M and was safely held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置，落後六個馬位。最後四百米僅能勉力而為，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W2W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, ridden along and sat outside the leader, weakened inside 250M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W2W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，在催策下居領放馬外側。二百五十米處轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled fairly, one pace to the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走勢一般。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, one-paced in the run home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳桯。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W1W2W) Shifted out and bumped out of stalls, driven along and outpaced early stages, raced in rear, ran on well final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W1W2W) 出閘時向外斜跑，與對手互相碰撞。早段受催策，但未能跟上步速，居後列。最後二百米以佳勢上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W1W1W) Sat box seat, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W1W1W) 居包廂位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W6W) Awkward start, recovered to race in mid-division, forced wide final bend, hung right home straight and never competitive (jockey reported that she was unable to fully test the horse final 400m).
