runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W6W) 出閘笨拙，恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路彎被迫走外疊。直路上內閃。從未有力一爭。（騎師報告，她在最後四百米未能全力催策坐騎。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W2W1W) Soon picked up to 5th 3-wide after sluggish start, continued to improve to join race leader 1400M out, hit the front on top of home bend 600M out and led until swamped inside final 200M. (Tactic questioned)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W2W1W) 出閘緩慢，瞬即加速，居第五位，走第三疊。持續上前，千四米處追上領放馬。六百米處開始轉直路彎時取得領先，領放直至最後二百米被超越。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Ole Kirk from Antonia, a daughter of Lope de Vega. Horses by the same sire include Gallant Design and Radiant Path. The fellow was given eight trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third under slight pressure, beaten 4Ls, over 800m on turf in Conghua on March 2. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 2Ls, over 1600m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「童夢奇才」(Ole Kirk)之後，在港同父馬包括「創寶駒」及「睿明途嘉」等駒，生母出自「戲劇泰斗」(Lope de Vega)。抵港後八次試閘一次上名。3月2日出試從化草地800米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬四個馬位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1600米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬兩個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Crossed to the lead 1000M setting good pace in the middle stages, had 1L lead and still going well mid-straight, run ended 100M out and caught by pursuers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 一千米處切入帶頭，中段以快步速領放。直路中段領先一個馬位，走勢仍佳。一百米處無以為繼，被後上馬匹超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sent forward to lead, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running from a wide barrier setting a steady pace, ridden some 3L clear about 150M out, hung on well to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後瞬即帶頭，以平穩步速領放。約一百五十米處受催策，帶離約三個馬位。保持佳勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, ran on strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。末段以勁勢上前，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, moved a bit closer after passing 900M, 4 wide turning in, made good progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。跑過九百米處後略為追近。入直路時走第四疊。直路上追前甚多，跑獲亞軍，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Tracked leaders, under pressure to chase leaders 500m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W4W) Out with rest, raced 2 wide better than midfield, angled out after passing 400M, very wide turning in, weakened and eased early in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。跑過四百米處後向外移出。轉入直路時走大外疊。直路初轉弱及收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) From wide draw left racing without cover, moved up to chase leader approaching home turn, there to strike turning home but found little passing 200M and drifted out of contention.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後未能取得遮擋。趨近直路彎時上前追趕領放馬。轉入直路時居相同位置，蓄勢待發。跑過二百米處時無甚餘力，再無爭勝機會。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W2W) Pressured when sharing the lead, weakened over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 並排領先下受追迫。末段轉弱。（ 見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Well there, became 3rd some 1.5L back rounding home bend, renewed effort over 600M out sharing lead into straight, folded up quickly inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居好位。轉直路彎時居第三位，落後約一個半馬位。六百米處重新發力。入直路時並排領先。最後一百米迅速力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Showed speed to get across, headed by rivals top of home straight, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 展現前速以切入內疊。直路初被對手超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled 3 wide near midfield, just one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居接近中間位置，走第三疊。在催策下僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, pressured for lead and one of three that raced clear to halfway, headed over 200m out, weakened, eased final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 帶頭競跑。在催策下保持領先位置，為半程前拋離馬群的三駒之一。二百米處被超越，轉弱。最後五十米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Jumped well, sent forward to take the lead, led by 3/4L turning in, kept on well in straight but unable to hold off the winner final 200M, finished 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先四分三個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但最後二百米未能抗衡頭馬，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W2W3W) Settled midfield, traveled nicely, made steady progress under whip (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W2W3W) 居中間位置，走勢良佳。在鞭策下穩步上前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W3W3W3W2W) Moderately away, raced towards rear on the outside, sent forward 1000M, raced prominently on the outside in the middle stages, challenged the leader turning in, took the lead 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W3W3W3W2W) 出閘普通，居後列，走外疊。一千米處受催策上前，中段居前列，走外疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。二百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W2W2W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, settled in mid-field, commenced move out wide 900m out, took the lead 600m out, in control final 200m, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W2W2W1W) 出閘時發生碰撞，居中間位置。九百米處開始發力，走外疊。六百米處取得領先。最後二百米控制大局。帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) Began only fairly, raced at rear on the outside, improved on turn, 2 to 3 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走外疊。直路彎推進。入直路時落後兩至三個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W4W5W) Moderately away from the widest draw, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, made minor progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W4W5W) 自大外檔出閘普通，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (4W3W2W2W2W2W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide in midfield early, moved closer approaching 1600M, positioned 2 wide, 1/2L back in the middle stages, kept on well early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened thereafter.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(4W3W2W2W2W2W) 出閘普通，早段居中間位置，走第三疊。趨近千六米處時追近。中段落後半個馬位，走第二疊。直路早段保持佳勢。一百五十米處未能再增速。其後轉弱。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced at rear on the inside, 2 wide from 800M, 5 lengths or so back on turn, made little progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。自八百米處起走第二疊。直路彎落後約五個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, finished off nicely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Rail position in mid-field, raced very keenly middle stages, commenced move out wide 750m out, weakened final 250m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，走內欄。中段十分搶口。七百五十米處開始發力，走外疊。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) From gate 13 sat handy with cover within striking distance of the leader, momentarily hit the front 250M out, boxed on nicely just unable to hold off late challengers.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 自第十三檔出閘，居前列，落後領放馬不遠，有遮擋。二百五十米處一度取得領先。以佳勢力拼，但末段未能抗衡對手的挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced behind midfield on the outside, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 自大外檔出閘，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, raced keenly throughout, made no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。沿途搶口。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) One of quickest away from the stalls, raced keenly in the early stages, held up for a short distance early part of the straight, knuckled down to the task once clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘最快馬匹之一。早段搶口。直路早段在一段短途程上受困。末段望空後瞬即力拼上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped with them, raced slightly behind midfield the inside, 5 lengths back turning in, made little progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W5W) Settled in front of midfield, was taken wider near the Home Turn, failed to respond thereafter (Disappointing performance, Must BT, See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W5W) 居中間之前位置。接近直路彎時被帶出較外疊，其後對催策毫無反應。（表現令人失望。必須試閘及格後，才可再次出賽。見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Settled just off midfield 2 wide, shuffled back in the middle stages, no clear run early part of the Straight, closed off once in the clear. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間稍後位置，走第二疊。中段墮居後列。直路早段未能望空，望空後隨即衝刺。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W2W) Tracked leader, ridden and outpaced 400m out, stayed on final 150m, tight for room between rivals closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。四百米處受催策，被拋離。最後一百五十米保持走勢。末段在馬匹之間受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, closed off well to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Sat 3 wide behind midfield, closed off nicely, no threat to top 2.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Crowded at start settling in midfield, baulked briefly for a run over 350M out, finished off the race well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 起步時受擠迫，居中間位置。三百五十米處一度受困。末段衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Sat on pace, weakened passing the 150M, minor ground made in the Straight (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 居前列。跑過一百五十米處時轉弱。直路上略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Soon recovered to midfield in 7th along the rail after moderate start, gained one better to 6th inside the 800M, kept on well inside final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居中間第七位，走內欄。八百米處追前一位至第六位。最後一百米保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Away awkwardly, reserved behind midfield along the inside, couldn't quicken passing 400M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走內疊。跑過四百米處時未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Always rear, forced to check 900M out dropping to last, made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 一直居後列。九百米處被迫勒避，墮居包尾位置。再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Jumped on terms, not far from leaders early before easing back to midfield, worked into the race well 400M, ran on solidly to get amongst the placings.
sustained a laceration to the left hind fetlock.
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: sustained a laceration to the left hind fetlock.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極慢步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出。早段落後領先馬匹不遠，其後收慢留居中間位置。四百米處以佳勢上前。末段衝刺不俗，跑獲季軍。
左後球節割傷。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W5W) Settled worse than midfield 2 wide, ran on without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W5W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。保持走勢，但未能構成任何威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W1W2W) Wide early from high draw, led after 400m, headed 600m out, remained prominent until no extra final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W1W2W) 自外檔出閘，早段走外疊。跑了四百米後取得領先。六百米處被超越。仍居前列，直至最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (2W2W) Jumped ok, sat midfield one off the rail, hit the line strongly when asked, just missed by a whisker.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(2W2W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。在催策下衝刺強勁，僅以短馬頭位之差落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Began well from a middle draw, settled down 2-wide in midfield, lay in when placed under pressure in the home straight, ran to the line steadily for 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第七檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上在催策下內閃。末段以穩勢上前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, unable to secure clear run until 150m out, stayed on but unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。未能望空直至一百五十米處。保持走勢，但未能追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) A bit outpaced early and raced in last place, short of room when trying to improve 300m out, switched and ran on final 250m, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 早段略為未能跟上步速，居包尾位置。三百米處在嘗試推進時空位不足。最後二百五十米轉換跑線及追前，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Raced wide no cover in mid-division, took time to muster in the straight, made ground final 200M without posing a serious threat to first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路上加速需時。最後二百米追前，但未能真正威脅首數名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover off pace, weakened in the Straight. (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居領先馬匹之後，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路上轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Broke well from a wide barrier settling in midfield between runners, came under pressure to challenge upon straightening but did not find much room until inside the 200M, quickened well to snatch 2nd final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，在馬匹之間競跑。入直路時在催策下展開挑戰，但空位不足直至二百米處。以佳勢加速，最後數步跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Across from wide draw and raced outside of leader, took narrow lead 300m out, headed 200m out and no extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入，居領放馬外側。三百米處以短距離領先。二百米處被超越，再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover for the majority of the race, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居中間位置，走外疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。直路初未能再增速。其後逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped in from wide draw, struggling in rear when checked 350m out, well held after.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，向內移入。在後列掙扎上前，三百五十米處勒避，其後落後頗遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Began awkwardly, raced at tail, 7-3/4L back turning in, taken wide in straight and made some progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘笨拙，居包尾位置。入直路時落後七又四分三個馬位。直路上移出外疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Held up, still in rear and under pressure 200m out, stayed on down the outside, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 留後。二百米處仍居後列，受催策。沿外疊保持走勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Awkward start, chased leader, dropped away quickly from 500m out, soon well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，追趕領放馬。自五百米處起迅速墮退，瞬即遙遙落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Fast into stride from draw 1 to take the lead, pressed by rival early and middle stages, struggled to keep up passing 300M, faded towards the finish. (Jockey - unsuited by being pressured in the lead.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，取得領先。早段及中段被對手追迫。跑過三百米處時掙扎上前。接近終點時轉弱。（騎師表示，坐騎在領放下被追迫不利發揮。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled handy, traveled fairly, slightly weakened over the concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。走勢一般，末段略為轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W) Sent to forward to lead, kept on nicely without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W) 受催策上前，取得領先。保持佳勢，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Tracked pace, pushed along turning into home straight, weakened gradually.
(Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained an abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領放馬。轉入直路時受推策。末段逐漸轉弱。
（左前腿擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, closed off strongly
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Ridden forward from a wide barrier reaching 2nd 3-wide 1100M out, one-out-one back rounding home bend holding every chance into straight, unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後受催策上前。千一米處進佔第二位，走第三疊。轉直路彎時落後一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時一度甚具爭勝機會。最後一百五十米無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W5W) Travelled 4-wide without cover in back straight, obtained cover 3-wide rounding home bend, carried very wide entering home straight, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W5W) 對面直路上走第四疊，沒有遮擋。轉直路彎時走第三疊，取得遮擋。入直路時被帶出大外疊。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) From an awkward draw caught out on a limb, boxed on solidly considering the tough run.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，走外疊，沒有遮擋。儘管耗力甚多，仍持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Crowded leaving stalls and also shuffled back around halfway, towards rear, stayed on from 400m out, moved into third 150m out, no further impression on front two closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 出閘時受擠迫。大約半程時墮居後列。自四百米處起持續上前，一百五十米處居第三位。末段未能進一步威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, asked for effort 400m out, stayed on but lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處受催策。保持走勢，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Held up from wide draw, always in rear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。一直居後列。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) Outpaced in last place, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 居包尾位置，未能跟上步速。入直路時受推策。末段未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Soon dropped to last few from a wide barrier, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘，瞬即墮居最後數位之內。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, raced towards rear, headway from halfway, hampered briefly 250m out, stayed on, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列。自半程起追前。二百五十米處一度受阻礙。保持走勢，未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Sat last, made headway final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 居包尾位置。最後一百米追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W2W) Set towards rear on the rail, weakened in the home turn then eased. (See incident report.)
(Bled.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。直路彎轉弱，其後收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）
（流鼻血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Settled in front of rear 3 wide, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，走第三疊。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped start, raced at rear on outer, 6 lengths or so back, very wide into straight, failed to make any progress in the run home. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居後列，落後約六個馬位，走外疊。入直路時走大外疊。末段毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled some 2L off the pace on rail, in similar position in 4th rounding home bend, obtained a run shortly after straightening and hit the front over 200M out, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 落後領放馬約兩個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時居相若的第四位。入直路後不久取位上前。二百米處取得領先。僅保住優勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled in last few from a wide barrier and waited with on rail, commenced move on the inside after straightening, reached 3rd late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘後居最後數位之內，留力候上，走內欄。入直路後沿內疊開始上前。末段跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, made minor ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Settled behind midfield, limited response when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間之後位置。對催策反應平平。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Shifted out at start and made contact, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Settled in mid-field, unable to hold position by halfway, bumped 300m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置。半程起未能保持位置。三百米處與對手互相碰撞。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear, in similar position turning for home, ran home only fairly. Never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列。轉直路彎時位置相若。末段衝刺僅屬一般。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled behind midfield, responded nicely over the concluding stages (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之後位置。末段對催策反應良佳。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) From wide draw pressed forward to be tracking leaders, raced wide no cover throughout, responded well from 400M to briefly go 2nd mid-straight, couldn't sprint with leaders final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘，受催策上前以跟隨領先馬匹。沿途走外疊，沒有遮擋。自四百米處起對催策反應良佳。直路中段一度進佔第二位。末段未能與領先馬匹一起衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled handy, held up in the early Straight, closed off reasonably well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居前列。直路早段受困，末段衝刺不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Held up in wide position, some headway final 300m, never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 留後，走外疊。最後三百米略為追前。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (4W4W) In touch, raced wide, soon lost ground turning into home straight, held when hampered 200m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(4W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走外疊。轉入直路時瞬即失地。二百米處受阻礙時受困。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Away with them, raced 3 wide with cover, 2 lengths or so back, carried wider 550M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 與對手同步出閘，落後約兩個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。五百五十米處被帶出更外疊。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in front of midfield, traveled greenly, had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early Straight, showed dash over the final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走勢稚嫩。直路初難以望空。最後一百米加速上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along 300m out, closed up late but never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W3W) 居後列，留力候上。三百米處受推策。末段追近，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, short of room early in home straight, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W2W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初空位不足。未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along widest into home straight, briefly hampered 100m out, never a threat.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。一百米處一度受阻礙。從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W) Held up in last pair, no impression under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W) 留居最後兩位之內。在催策下毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W1W1W) Mid-field, headway from 400m out, still fourth 100m out, stayed on strongly to edge ahead close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W1W1W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起上前，一百米處仍居第四位。保持勁勢，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W1W) Began only fairly, raced in midfield on the inside, 3 lengths back, saved ground on turn, kept on evenly in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，落後三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Mid-field, pushed along 400m out, unable to quicken, stayed on late, no threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。四百米處受推策，未能加速。末段保持走勢，未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Obtained a midfield position 3-4Ls off the pace, quickened up nicely from top of the straight, ran home well final 200M but just found winner too strong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位。自直路初起以佳勢加速。最後二百米衝刺良佳，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Slowly away, in rear, pushed along before most, stayed on, encouraging debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢，居後列，較大部分對手更早受推策。保持走勢。初出表現令人鼓舞。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Tracked pace, headway into contention 300m out, stuck to task.
sustained a small abrasion to the right hind leg.
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: sustained a small abrasion to the right hind leg.
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。三百米處上前爭勝。持續力拼。
右後腿輕微擦傷。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Broke well from a wide barrier but taken backward to behind midfield 3-wide, taken wider into straight, obtained a clear run 300M out and ran on well to be nearest at finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 自外檔出閘迅速，但留居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時移出更外疊。三百米處望空，以佳勢追前。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Broke well from a wide barrier before gradually settling in 8th for cover just inside the 1100M, slightly further back in quickened pace 800M out, ran on steadily inside final 400M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 自外檔出閘迅速。跑過千一米處後逐漸居第八位以取得遮擋。八百米處略為進一步落後步速加快的領放馬。最後四百米穩步上前，未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Sat midfield on the rail, made little impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。無甚表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Bumped shortly after start, waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, made up some late ground but never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段略為追前，但從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Jumped well before being restrained to a midfield position 4-5Ls off the pace, fought on steadily final 400M but was always held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，其後受約束，居中間位置，落後領放馬四至五個馬位。最後四百米持續力拼，但一直落後領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, ended up racing at the rear group, had some work to do top of the straight but couldn't quicken enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後列。直路初仍落後頗遠，但加速力不足。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Out with rest, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, 3 wide turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened final 150M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百五十米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Jumped awkwardly, sat rear, failed to run out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列。未能應付途程。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W4W) Jumped only fairly, settled towards the rear 8-9Ls back, swung widest into straight before running on mildly to line. No threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，落後八至九個馬位。入直路時移出最外疊，其後保持普通走勢至終點。未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Jumped only fairly, raced 2 wide towards rear, 7 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well from an inside barrier, settled down in midfield along the fence, fought hard passing 400M but was always held by first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自內檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內欄。跑過四百米處時力拼，但一直落後首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Slightly impeded leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, challenged up rail 300m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘時略為受阻，居中間位置，走內欄。三百米處沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W5W) Raced in rear out wide, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to improve position, eased when detached 100m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W5W) 居後列，走外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能推進。一百米處被拋離時收慢。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PPG, a 4-year-old gelding, by Churchill from Bagitol, a daughter of Pierro. Horses by the same sire include Ka Ying Generation and Gutsy Bravo. He was given seven trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far off the pace and finished fifth, beaten by 10-1/4Ls, under slight pressure over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「邱吉爾」(Churchill)之後，在港同父馬包括「嘉應傳承」及「彪形勇將」等駒，生母出自「比亞路」(Pierro)。抵港後試閘七次。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段稍騎下跑第五名，落後頭馬10.25個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Settled midfield, overraced in the early stages, made some headway early part of the home straight, run came to end from 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置，早段搶口。直路初略為追前。自一百五十米處起無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (1W2W) Raced in touch, sticking to task but lacked speed to challenge when short of room 150m out to 50m out.
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。持續力拼，但一百五十米處至五十米處之間空位不足，未能增速以展開挑戰。
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Stayed close enough in the group chasing leaders, quickly beaten turning home and dropped away.
(Blood in trachea and continuous epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Blood in trachea and continuous epiglottic entrapment.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 居於追趕領先馬匹的馬群中，保持落後不遠。轉入直路時迅速洩氣，墮退。
（氣管有血及會厭持續被覆蓋。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （氣管有血及會厭持續被覆蓋。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Sat box seat, held up in the Straight, made good late ground once in the clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。直路上受困，末段望空後追前甚多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Tracked pace against rail, had to wait for run 400m out, quickened between rivals to lead 250m out, soon clear.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，走內欄。四百米處須等待空位出現。二百五十米處在對手之間加速，取得領先。瞬即帶離對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W4W) In touch with leaders, hung left early on, under pressure 300m out, weakened.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W4W) 跟隨領先馬匹，早段外閃。三百米處受催策，轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, ridden 400m out, weakened final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追逼領放馬。四百米處受催策。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Never better than midfield, inconvenienced for a stride about 800M out, one-paced under pressure in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 從未超越中間位置。約八百米處一度受妨礙。直路上在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Keen early, waited with in rear, last at halfway, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 早段搶口，居後列，留力候上。半程時居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, challenged by rivals from 600m out, headed 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速以領放。自六百米處起受對手挑戰。三百米處被超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W2W) Sat on pace 2 wide, kept on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W2W) 居前列，走第二疊。末段保持走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W1W) Began smartly, took the lead, shared lead with rival in the middle stages, peaked and headed near 200M, weakened final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，取得領先。中段與對手並排領先。接近二百米處時未能再增速及被超越。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W1W1W) Sat on pace, weakened from the 600M. (Unacceptable Performance, must trial) (See Incident Report)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W1W1W) 居前列。自六百米處起轉弱。（表現難以接受，必須試閘及格。）（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Jumped well and led, kept on until weakened final 75M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。保持走勢，最後七十五米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Broke well settling just off the pace in 2nd, came to join race leader rounding home bend holding every chance in straight until unable to sustain effort inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居領放馬稍後的第二位。轉直路彎時追上領放馬。直路上一度甚具爭勝機會，但最後一百五十米後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Made all, kicked 300m out and three lengths clear 100m out, margin reduced closing stages but always doing enough.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 全程領放。三百米處加速。一百米處帶離三個馬位。末段領先距離收窄，但一直保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Away from the stalls swiftly, soon let the speed go sat midfield along the rail, hit the line strongly only just went down by a whisker (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，瞬即放棄爭奪領先，居中間位置，走內欄。末段衝刺強勁，僅以短距離落敗。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W) Taken back from gate 11, raced at rear, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W) 自第十一檔出閘後留居後列。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Mid-field, stayed on final 250m, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。最後二百五十米保持走勢，未能增速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W) Across from wide draw to race outside of leader, stayed prominent until 200m out, faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W) 自大外檔出閘後切入內疊，居領放馬外側。保持居前列直至二百米處。其後力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, short-lived effort top of home straight, no extra final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。直路初一度發力。最後一百五十米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Raced in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, headway up rail final 200m, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。最後二百米沿欄上前。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W2W) Away well, positioned 2 wide in midfield in the early stages, slightly dropped towards rear after passing 600M, 4 lengths or so back turning in, showed no response in straight, eased final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W2W) 出閘迅速，早段居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過六百米處後略為墮居後列。轉入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上對催策毫無反應。最後一百米收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow() (1W1W) Recovered quickly on rail from awkward start to midfield about 4L off the pace, in similar position in 7th rounding home bend but baulked for a run after straightening, finished off the race well inside final 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速()(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，其後迅速恢復走勢，進佔中間位置，落後領放馬約四個馬位，走內欄。轉直路彎時居相若的第七位，但入直路後受阻。最後一百五十米衝刺良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, stayed on under pressure final 200m, never a threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。最後二百米在催策下保持走勢。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Settled midfield, traveled okay, no clear run over the final 150M, could not be fully tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置。走勢不俗。最後一百五十米未能望空，未能全力施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Towards rear of mid-field, headway into third 150m out, stayed on but no danger to front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。一百五十米處上前進佔第三位。保持走勢，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (5W3W3W) Moderately away from a wide draw, raced in midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(5W3W3W) 自外檔出閘普通，居中間位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Very slowly away, soon recovered to rear end of the field, in a similar position into straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘非常緩慢，瞬即回復走勢，居馬群後列。入直路時位置相若。以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W) Mid-field, followed runner-up through over 200m out, ran on strongly to lead late on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W) 居中間位置。二百米處跟隨亞軍馬匹上前。走勢強勁，末段取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W3W) Crowded for room shortly after start, raced in rear, still plenty to do when checked briefly 350m out, stayed on strongly final 200m despite edging right.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列。三百五十米處仍落後甚遠，一度勒避。最後二百米儘管曾內閃，但仍保持勁勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped back from a wide draw, at the rear early stages before moving closer to midfield making the turn for room, closed off moderately final 300M without troubling leaders. (Held up near 100M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 自大外檔出閘，留後。早段居後列，轉直路彎時追近至中間位置以取位。最後三百米衝刺普通，未能威脅領先馬匹。（接近一百米處時受困。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W) Moderately away from gate 9, raced 3 wide behind midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to be nearest on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W) 自第九檔出閘普通，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Ridden early before gradually dropping to midfield or slightly worse 3-wide, made no impression in the run to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 早段受催策，其後逐漸墮居中間或中間稍後位置，走第三疊。末段毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W) Held up, well held from top of home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W) 留後。自直路初起落後甚遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W3W) Sat behind midfield on the rail, stayed on only fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段僅保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W5W) Very slowly away losing considerable ground, trailed the field most of the way and the widest into straight, never seen with a chance.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W5W) 出閘十分緩慢，失地甚多，大部分途程尾隨馬群。入直路時走最外疊。從未看似有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Towards rear, pushed along when checked briefly 500m out, struggling and left behind final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居後列。五百米處受推策，一度勒避。最後三百米掙扎上前及被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Held up last, still in last pair top of home straight, lacked pace to challenge, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 留居包尾位置。直路初仍居最後兩位之內。欠缺速度以展開挑戰。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Began only fairly, ended up racing near last, had some work to do 400M but responded only fairly to pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居接近包尾位置。四百米處落後頗遠，但對催策反應僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Soon taken back from a wide barrier, trailed the field from about 1300M out, made modest progress past well-beaten horses in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 自最外檔出閘，瞬即留後。自約千三米處起尾隨馬群。直路上略為追前，超越數匹已洩氣潰敗的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded on jumping, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out after turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 躍出時受擠迫，居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後向外移出。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W4W) Given a waiting ride towards the rear of the field, driven wide into straight then closed off fairly under top weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受催策，走外疊。在負頂磅下於末段衝刺僅屬一般。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (3W5W) Shifted out and bumped leaving stalls, mid division, switched wide into home straight, ran on strongly to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(3W5W) 出閘時向外斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置。入直路時移出外疊。以勁勢上前，二百米處取得領先，其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, checked 900m out, short of room early in home straight, forced to steady 200m out, unable to recover.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。九百米處勒避。直路早段空位不足。二百米處被迫收慢。未能恢復走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W4W) Shifted out at start, raced behind midfield on the outside, a bit closer on turn, showed very good response in straight, took the lead approaching 150M, kept on very well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上對催策反應甚佳。趨近一百五十米處時取得領先。保持甚佳走勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, tight for room between horses early in home straight, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。直路早段在馬匹之間受緊迫。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made contact shortly after start, raced behind midfield, saved ground on turn, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled behind midfield 2 wide, hampered when switching out on the Home Turn, made some ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎向外移出時受阻礙，略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Tagaloa from Rekindled Glow, a daughter of Redoute's Choice. Horses by the same sire include Baby Sakura and Polar Patch. The fellow had six starts for two wins (a 3yo+ maiden over 1200m and a handicap over 1340m) and four placings (including a 3yo handicap listed over 1400m and a 3yo group 2 over 1600m). He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat last and finished third under slight pressure, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, over 1600m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. He should run a decent race, with better to come.
formguide.comments_chi: Tagaloa之後，在港同父馬包括「櫻花酒杯」及「北極之錶」等駒，生母出自「利得精選」(Redoute's Choice)。來港前在澳洲六戰得兩勝四位，頭馬包括一場1200米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽，及一場1340米讓磅賽，上名賽事包括一場1400米三歲表列讓磅賽，及一場1600米三歲二級賽。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。最近10月13日出試田草1600米，早段居包尾位置，末段稍騎下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出或有一定走勢，熱身後應會更進步。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Shifted in at start and bumped, raced 2 wide in midfield, there to turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 起步時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路初未能望空，其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders late but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。最後二百米以佳勢上前，末段追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 wide turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊。直路早段未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run early in straight, made contact near 250M, eased inside final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。接近二百五十米處時與對手互相觸碰。最後二百米收慢。（見競賽事件報告。）

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Proisir from Chapinta, a daughter of High Chaparral. Horses by the same sire include Sunny Da Best and Flow Water Flow. The fellow had eight starts for two wins (a maiden over 1400m and a handicap over 1600m) and three placings (including a 3yo group three over 1600m). He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he was taken back and finished eighth under the whip, beaten by 5Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: Proisir之後，在港同父馬包括「新力好」及「細水長流」等駒，生母出自「灌木叢」(High Chaparral)。來港前在紐西蘭八戰得兩勝三位，頭馬包括一場1400米從未勝出馬賽，及一場1600米讓磅賽，上名賽事包括一場1600米三歲三級賽。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月23日出試從化草地1200米，起步居後，末段鞭策下跑第八名，落後頭馬五個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W4W) Jumped with them, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider on turn, finished off strongly to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎走更外疊。末段衝刺強勁，取得季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Taken back from gate 12, raced at rear, 2 wide, 5 lengths or so back turning in, made good progress in straight to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第十二檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約五個馬位。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in rear, switched wide for clear run 300m out, never on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 居後列。三百米處移出外疊以望空。從未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W5W) Awkward start and lost ground, detached early stages, good headway halfway out, pushed along widest into home straight, passed plenty of field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W5W) 出閘笨拙及失地，早段被拋離。半程時追前甚多。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。末段超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Began awkwardly, raced as the rear over 10Ls off the pace at one stage, had task in hand leaving the bend, failed to make up ground on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙，居後列，一度落後領放馬逾十個馬位。跑離直路彎時落後頗遠。未能追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, under pressure 600m out, unable to quicken, eased final 100m.
(Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Roarer again and sustained a minor abrasion to the right hind leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。六百米處受催策，未能加速。最後一百米收慢。
（再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）
runnerrecords.healthissue_chi: （再次患有喘鳴症及右後腿輕微擦傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good to fast; (3W6W) Bumped start, raced 3 wide behind midfield, no cover for the majority of the race, very wide turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened final furlong. (See Racing Incidents.)
(Roarer again.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等偏快步速;(3W6W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。大部分途程沒有遮擋。入直路時走大外疊，直路早段未能再增速。最後二百米轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）
（再次患有喘鳴症。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W1W) Tracked leader, well placed into home straight, under pressure 400m out, weakened quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W1W) 跟隨領放馬。入直路時居好位。四百米處受催策。最後二百米迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(+) (1W1W) Soon led under 7lb claimer, set steady pace and let down powerfully when asked from 350M, was strong through the line putting a good gap on the field.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(+)(1W1W) 由獲減七磅的騎師策騎，早段瞬即帶頭競跑，以平穩步速領放。自三百五十米處起受催策，展開凌厲衝刺。帶離餘駒一段距離，以勁勢衝線掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Recovered quickly from an awkward start to soon take up running, held 1L advantage rounding home bend and into straight, hung on well under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘笨拙，迅速恢復走勢，瞬即取得領先。轉直路彎及入直路時領先一個馬位。在催策下保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Wide without cover in midfield after beginning from a wide barrier, shifted back to 11th for cover 3-wide approaching first bend 1000M out, made no impression from wide into straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘後居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。一千米處趨近首個彎位時留居第十一位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時走外疊，毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Sat outside lead, kept on okay, always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居領放馬外側。保持不俗走勢，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Heavily bumped and lost balance shortly after start, raced in touch with leaders, good headway halfway out, ran on well to close on leaders but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久被大力碰撞，失去平衡，跟隨領先馬匹。半程時以佳勢上前。走勢良佳，追近領先馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; In rear after awkward start, never any room to open up from 300m out, coasted past a few rivals final 150m, never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;出閘笨拙，其後居後列。自三百米處起從未能望空。最後一百五十米輕鬆超越數匹對手。從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W2W1W1W) Had to work hard getting across to the lead, pressed by a rival down the back straight setting fast pace throughout, had no extra mid-straight. (Jockey was told she should endeavour to set a more sustainable pace.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W2W1W1W) 須受力策以切入領放。沿途以快步速領放，對面直路上受一駒追迫。直路中段再無餘力。（小組告誡騎師，她應嘗試讓坐騎以可持續更久的步速領放。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped with them, sent forward to take the lead, led by 1/2L turning in, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed approaching 100M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 與對手同步躍出，受催策上前取得領先。入直路時領先半個馬位。直路初保持佳勢。趨近一百米處時未能再增速，被超越。其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, two lengths clear into home straight, headed by winner 200m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。入直路時領先兩個馬位。二百米處被頭馬超越，最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(-) (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked top of home straight, headed by winner 200m out, no match for winner, just held second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(-)(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。直路初加速。二百米處被頭馬超越。未能與頭馬抗衡，僅保住亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Began well to make all obtaining rails run over 1000M out, held over 1L advantage most of way before ridden clear 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。一千米處移入內欄。大部分途程領先逾一個馬位，三百米處在催策下帶離勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Soon took up running after beginning from the one draw attempting to make all, defied serious challenge after straightening to re-gain advantage 150M out only to be denied close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後瞬即領放，嘗試一放到底。入直路後力拒對手的強勁挑戰，一百五十米處再次拉開與對手的距離。僅於接近終點時被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (4W3W) Raced wide without cover, chased along early, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(4W3W) 走外疊，沒有遮擋，早段追趕對手。直路上迅速墮退。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Waited with towards rear, still in rear top of home straight, switched for clear run 200m out, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, switched for clear run 500m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。未能加速以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W1W1W) Rail position in mid-field, had to wait for run turning into home straight, challenged up rail from 200m out, stayed on but no match for leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。入直路時須等待空位出現。自二百米處起沿欄展開挑戰。末段保持走勢，但不敵領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Taken back to race towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run until 150M, made some progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。未能望空直至一百五十米處，其後略為追前，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Awkward start, three wide in rear of mid-field, taken wider on bend, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。直路彎移出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Settled towards the rear on the rail, closed off strongly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居後列，走內欄。衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, closed off nicely, no threat to winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced at rear on the outside, there to turn, one-paced in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, tracked pace out wide without cover, quickened early to lead 250m out, headed by winner 200m out, tired closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初加速，二百五十米處取得領先。二百米處被頭馬超越，末段呈現疲態。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, short of room top of home straight, checked 350m out, clear run 250m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。直路初空位不足，三百五十米處勒避。二百五十米處望空，末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W4W) Settled worse than behind midfield 3 wide, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W4W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W4W) Moderately away, raced 2 wide in midfield, commenced move 400M, very wide turning in, made some progress early in straight, no extra final 100M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W4W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處開始上前。入直路時走大外疊。直路初略為追前。最後一百米再無餘力。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Taken back from gate 10, raced 3 wide behind midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, wider from 550M, made some progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 自第十檔出閘，居中間之後位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。自五百五十米處起走更外疊。直路早段略為追前，一百五十米處未能再增速，最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, positioned 3 lengths behind the leader on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, cleared 300M, closed off well to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，落後領放馬三個馬位，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。三百米處望空，以佳勢衝刺，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Deep Field from My Goodness, a daughter of Lonhro. Horses by the same sire include Voyage Bubble and Self Improvement. The fellow had three starts for one win (a maiden over 1600m) and one placing in New Zealand. He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished seventh, beaten 3-1/2Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「遙遠星空」(Deep Field)之後，在港同父馬包括「遨遊氣泡」及「自強不息」等駒，生母出自「白金礦」(Lonhro)。來港前在紐西蘭三戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1600米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第七名，落後頭馬3.5個馬位。首戰熱身為主。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped shortly after start, raced towards rear on the middle track, hard ridden after passing 400M, made some progress thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後不久發生碰撞，居後列，在跑道中央競跑。跑過四百米處後受力策。其後略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Jumped on terms, settled towards the back of the field in 13th 6-7Ls off, did best work final 250M but failed to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;與對手同步躍出，居後列第十三位，落後六至七個馬位。最後二百五十米表現最佳，但未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Soon dropped to the rear, produced late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;瞬即墮居後列。末段略為上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Close up to leaders early before settling behind mid-pack in middle stages, stayed on steadily final 200M under big weight but never troubled leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段緊隨領先馬匹，其後於中段居中間之後位置。最後二百米在負重磅下保持穩勢，但從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Average to begin, raced 2 wide towards rear, 4 lengths or so back turning in, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘一般，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。末段衝刺平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Driven along and outpaced early stages, briefly short of room 350m out, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;早段受催策，但未能跟上步速。三百五十米處一度空位不足。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (2W4W) Away well but restrained early to be last in the field, ran past a few tired rivals in the final stages (See Incident Report).
(Blood in trachea.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘迅速，但早段受約束，居包尾位置。末段超越數匹已呈疲態的對手。（見競賽事件報告。）
（氣管有血。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Settled in second half of the field early stages, moved up to midfield middle stages but ran home only one paced final straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段居後半馬群中。中段上前至中間位置，但直路上僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slowly away, some headway early in home straight, left behind final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘緩慢。直路早段略為追前。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Tracked leaders against rail, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out, lost touch final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹，走內欄。自四百米處起受催策，但未能加速。最後二百米被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Rail position in mid-field, short of room behind leaders early in home straight and hampered 200m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。直路初在領先馬匹之後空位不足，二百米處受阻礙，速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W2W) Settled midfield on the rail, under pressure from 600M, gave ground in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。自六百米處起受催策。直路上墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (5W5W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, moved closer on turn, 3 lengths back turning in, peaked early in straight, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(5W5W) 留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎追近。入直路時落後三個馬位。直路早段未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W) Keen in mid-field, tight for room briefly 300m out, weakened.
(Lost left hind plate.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置，搶口。三百米處一度受緊迫，其後轉弱。
（失去左後蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W4W) Held up in rear, had to wait for run briefly 350m out, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W4W) 留居後列。三百五十米處一度須等待空位出現。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Restrained from the wide barrier in the early stages and settled towards the rear, had some work to do 400M, ran on well enough but couldn't quite get there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 自外檔出閘，於早段受約束，居後列。四百米處落後頗遠。走勢良佳，但未能追上頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled down in mid-division 6Ls off leader, travelled well turning for home, had to shift to outside for clear running mid-straight before getting home strongly to lead near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬六個馬位。轉直路彎時走勢良佳。直路中段須移出外疊以望空。末段衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, keen 750m out, under pressure 500m out, ran on strongly to lead 150m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。七百五十米處搶口。五百米處受催策。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W1W) Taken well back from the widest barrier and waited with, commenced move on rail home bend saving ground for 2.5L 7th into straight, obtained clear run back on rail 200M out, ran on dourly under pressure to just fail.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後遙居後列，留力候上。直路彎開始發力，走內欄以省腳程。入直路時居第七位，落後兩個半馬位。二百米處移回內欄望空。在催策下持續力拼，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W5W) Not hurried and settled near last in early and middle stages, brought wide for home before staying on well to take 5th on testing ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W5W) 早段及中段未受催策，居接近包尾位置。入直路時移出外疊。其後保持佳勢，跑軟地取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, struggled to hold position from 500m out, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。自五百米處起難以保持位置。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W1W1W) Soon took up running setting a sound pace and attempting to make all, led until finding no extra inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 瞬即帶頭，以快步速領放，試圖一放到底。保持領先，直至最後三百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Raced keenly just off the pace, moved up to vie for lead from 800M, hard driven to gain narrow lead mid-straight, dug deep but couldn't hold off ROMANTIC WARRIOR in final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居領放馬稍後位置，搶口。上前，自八百米處起爭奪領先。受力策，直路中段領先短距離。力拼，但末段未能抗衡「浪漫勇士」。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Made running, joined by rivals top of home straight, headed by winner 300m out, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 領放。直路初被對手追及。三百米處被頭馬超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Pressed forward from a poor draw to soon take up running on rail attempting to make all in a smart pace, led the field until finding no extra 200M out, hung on well for second.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前，瞬即沿欄領放，嘗試以快步速一放到底。保持領先直至二百米處後勁不繼，但仍能保持佳勢跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Across to press leader, improved to lead 1000m out, ridden 400m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 切入追迫領放馬。上前，一千米處取得領先。四百米處受催策。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。其後持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Soon led, pressed by rival middle stages setting a fast pace to the straight, kept going well passing 400M, found extra mid-straight to beat off his nearest rival, went clear late stages. Impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 瞬即領放。中段被對手追迫。直路前以快步速領放。跑過四百米處時保持佳勢。直路中段加速，力拒第二位馬匹的挑戰，末段帶離對手，贏得漂亮。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W1W1W1W) Ridden along to lead, traveled smoothly, led all the way to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 在催策下取得領先，走勢暢順。一放到底掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Average to begin, sent forward to take the lead, travelled well to turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked and headed 200M, ran on evenly to the line.
(Jockey dropped the whip approaching the 150 Metres.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped the whip approaching the 150 Metres.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘普通，受催策上前帶頭。直路彎前走勢良佳。直路初保持佳勢，二百米處未能再增速，被超越，保持穩勢至終點。
（騎師於趨近一百五十米處時跌掉馬鞭。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （騎師於趨近一百五十米處時跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Settled down behind midfield 6-7Ls away, responded moderately from 400M, drove hard to just miss 3rd in a tight finish but couldn't pose much threat to the runaway winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，落後六至七個馬位。自四百米處起對催策反應普通。受力策，在多駒幾乎齊過終點下僅失季軍，但未能對遙遙領先的頭馬構成太多威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, ran on strongly final 300m, edged ahead close home in tight finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。最後三百米以勁勢追前。接近終點時取得領先，僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W5W) Towards rear in 7th after beginning from a wide barrier about 6L off the pace, went widest turning for home, ran on well inside final 300M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W5W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列第七位，落後領放馬約六個馬位。轉入直路時走最外疊。最後三百米以佳勢上前。末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Obtained running in midfield, picked up well on testing conditions from 400M, led passing 150M and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居中間位置。在軟地上自四百米處起加速良佳。跑過一百五十米處時取得領先，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped and lost balance shortly after start, waited with towards rear, keen 900m out, strong run to lead 100m out, cozy winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步後不久發生碰撞及失去平衡，居後列，留力候上。九百米處搶口。走勢強勁，一百米處取得領先，輕鬆勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Shifted in at start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, commenced move 550M, very wide into straight, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on strongly, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時向內斜跑，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。五百五十米處開始上前，入直路時走大外疊。直路上對催策反應甚佳，一百五十米處取得領先，保持勁勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Slow(-) (3W4W) Away with them, raced behind midfield on the outside, commenced move after passing 500M, finished off very strongly to be nearest on line.
(Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.incident_eng: (Jockey dropped right rein over the concluding stages.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
慢步速(-)(3W4W) 與對手同步出閘，居中間之後位置，走外疊。跑過五百米處後開始上前。衝刺凌厲，過終點時最為接近。
（於末段騎師右邊韁繩脫手。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W2W3W) Settled worse than midfield on the rail, held up top of Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受困。末段衝刺強勁，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W2W3W) Reserved near last 8Ls off the pace, had the task in hand 400M, brought wide into straight, came from a long way back and made solid inroads to finish 5th.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 留居接近包尾位置，落後領放馬八個馬位。四百米處仍落後頗遠。入直路時移出外疊，自遙遙落後的位置上前。末段追前甚多，取得第五名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled towards the rear 9-10Ls off the pace in early and middle stages, couldn't go on passing 400M, no extra mid-straight and weakened rapidly. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居後列，早段及中段落後領放馬九至十個馬位。跑過四百米處時無以為繼。直路中段再無餘力，迅速轉弱。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W3W) Began slowly losing ground, gradually recovered to just behind midfield on rail, crowded between runners entering home straight, kept on steadily under pressure without quickening inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W3W) 出閘緩慢，失地。逐漸恢復走勢，居中間稍後位置，走內欄。入直路時在馬匹之間受擠迫。最後三百米在催策下保持穩勢，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W5W) Sat midfield 2 wide, angled out near 550M, kept on well early in the straight, ran on evenly. (See incident report.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W5W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。接近五百五十米處時向外移出。直路早段保持佳勢，末段走勢平穩。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) From wide draw taken back and reserved near last, over 10Ls off leader middle stages, driven 450M and ran to the line well without troubling first few. Pleasing return after long absence.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 自外檔出閘後留居接近包尾位置。中段落後領放馬逾十個馬位。四百五十米處受催策。末段衝刺良佳，但未能威脅首數名馬匹。久休復出，表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Gradually settled towards the rear, shifted wide to challenge entering straight, ran on inside final 250M without threatening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 逐漸留居後列。入直路時移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百五十米上前，但未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W) Chased leaders in 3rd, moved up to 2nd 500M, couldn't sustain run passing mid-straight and was easily beaten final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W) 追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。五百米處進佔第二位。跑過直路中段時後勁不繼。末段被輕鬆擊敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Went forward to be chasing leader 2-wide, vied for lead from 300M but couldn't contain the pursuing rivals final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 上前追趕領放馬，走第二疊。自三百米處起爭奪領先，但末段未能抗衡後上的對手。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W) Pressed forward from wide draw without cover 1200M out to join the leader onto home bend, some 1L back 2-wide into the straight, weakened under pressure inside final 300M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W) 自大外檔出閘後受催策上前。千二米處沒有遮擋。開始轉直路彎時追上領放馬。入直路時落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。最後三百米在催策下轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon led setting steady pace in front under 10lb claimer, headed 350M but refused to give in, fought bravely to the line for a respectable 4th .
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即取得領先，以平穩步速領放。三百五十米處被超越，但奮力頑抗，力拼至終點，取得第四名，表現不俗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Soon led under 10lb claimer, set slow pace early stages before quickening up halfway, was strongly pressed by eventual 2nd final 250M but held on bravely.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 由獲讓十磅的見習騎師策騎，瞬即領放。早段以慢步速領放。半程時加速。最後二百五十米受亞軍馬匹以勁勢追迫，但力保勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) In front early stages but was restrained to race behind leader on settling, couldn't find extra gear to challenge passing 350M, faded final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 早段居前列，其後受約束以跟隨領放馬。跑過三百五十米處時未能加速以展開挑戰，末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front from 500m out, stayed on well in home straight but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。自五百米處起在領放下受追迫。直路上保持佳勢，但未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, never involved.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W2W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。從未參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W1W2W) Broke well from the one draw settling in 2nd chasing within 2L of the pace, came to challenge making final turn drawing level early in home straight, but no match to winner's burst of speed 300M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居第二位，追趕至落後領放馬不足兩個馬位。轉直路彎時展開挑戰。直路初並排領先，但三百米處未能與頭馬的加速力抗衡。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Caught wide early stages, improved to race outside leader, failed to pick up early straight and looked beaten, made up some ground late however and not beaten far by the placegetters at the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 早段走外疊，其後推進至領放馬外側。直路初未能加速，看似洩氣，但末段略為追前，終點線上負於入位馬匹不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Crowded at start, gradually settled in 5th on rail some 4L back, closer to lead when tempo slackened in back straight, came under pressure home bend and saved ground turning in, found no extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，逐漸居第五位，落後約四個馬位，走內欄。對面直路上在步速減慢下追近領放馬。直路彎受催策，入直路時走內疊節省腳程。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W2W) Tracked pace, shuffled back to mid-field 700m out, ridden and left behind final 400m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W2W) 跟隨領放馬。七百米處墮居中間位置。最後四百米受催策，但被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-division 3-4Ls off leader in a slowly run race, little change in position to the straight, kept on fairly to the line. Never dangerous.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，落後領放馬三至四個馬位，賽事步速緩慢。直路前位置大致不變。末段保持一般走勢，從未能構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Settled over 3L back in 5th, drifted slightly further off the pace in fast tempo around home bend, soon weakened under pressure after straightening.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 居第五位，落後逾三個馬位。轉直路彎時在快步速下略為墮後，進一步落後領放馬。入直路後在催策下瞬即轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Sat midfield 2 wide, closed off okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。末段衝刺尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) Given a quiet ride from draw 1, dropped back towards the rear along the inside, responded initially in early straight but couldn't sustain run final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第一檔出閘後留後，墮居後列，走內疊。直路早段起初對催策交出反應，但末段後勁不繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, outpaced middle stages, ran on well in home straight, short of room final 50m, unable to be ridden out to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。中段未能跟上步速。直路上保持佳勢。最後五十米空位不足，未能被力策至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (1W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced behind midfield on the inside, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, finished off well to take a place, no threat to the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(1W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居中間之後位置，走內疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。衝刺良佳，跑獲季軍，但未能威脅頭兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Tracked leader in a fast run race, fought on in the straight to claim 2nd close home but couldn't get near to the winner. (Jockey : lay out under pressure for the majority of home straight.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 跟隨領放馬，賽事步速甚快。直路上力拼。接近終點時進佔第二位，但未能追近頭馬。（騎師報告，坐騎在直路上大部分途程在催策下外閃。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W1W2W) Settled just behind midfield on rail, carried backward in slackened tempo to last 750m out, baulked for a run and switched 200M out, quickened well to hit the front 50M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W1W2W) 居中間稍後位置，走內欄。七百五十米處步速減慢時墮後至包尾位置。二百米處受困，向外移出。加速良佳，五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W1W2W) Slightly slow out, raced at rear on the inside, angled out approaching 350M, 6 lengths back turning in, made good progress in straight to make frame, no threat to the first few.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W1W2W) 出閘稍慢，居後列，走內疊。趨近三百五十米處時向外移出。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名，但未能威脅三甲馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (2W2W3W3W) Sat last early, made a forward move from the 800M, kept on fairly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(2W2W3W3W) 早段居包尾位置。自八百米處起上前。保持一般走勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Mid division, switched wide 900m out, pushed along wide into home straight, outpaced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置。九百米處移出外疊。入直路時受推策，走外疊。未能跟上步速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Raced in second half of the field 7Ls off leader, under pressure to keep up rounding home turn, failed to get involved in the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居後半馬群中，落後領放馬七個馬位。轉直路彎時受催策以跟上。末段未能參與競逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat just behind the leaders, showed good dash top of the Straight, run peaked at 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領先馬匹稍後位置。直路初加速良佳。一百米處未能再增速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W3W) Waited with in rear, pushed along wide into home straight, stayed on well and passed plenty of fields.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段保持佳勢，超越多駒。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W2W4W) Away well, raced 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, commenced move after passing 550M, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 150M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W2W4W) 出閘迅速，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。跑過五百五十米處後開始上前。直路上對催策反應甚佳。一百五十米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W3W) Bumped out of stalls, tracked leaders, moved smoothly into contention top of home straight, ran on well to get up on line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 出閘時發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初順勢上前挑戰。以佳勢上前，終點線上險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W3W2W2W) Caught 3 wide midfield early, improved from the 850M, nothing extra final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W3W2W2W) 早段居中間位置，走第三疊。自八百五十米處起推進。最後一百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W2W3W4W) Settled down in second half of the field, wide no cover from 700M, widest straightening with some work to do but came with a barnstorming run to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W2W3W4W) 居後半馬群中。自七百米處起走外疊，沒有遮擋。入直路時走最外疊，仍落後甚遠，但其後展開強勁衝刺，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W1W3W5W) Switched off to the rear early stages, raced as the back marker in a fast run race before commencing a wide move from 700M, came with a sustained bid to lead nearing 200M, kept on well to win comfortably.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W1W3W5W) 早段留居後列。在快步速下居包尾位置。自七百米處開始在外疊推進。持續上前，接近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，輕鬆掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Tightened at start settling in rear on rail and waited with, obtained a clear run near the centre of the track over 150M out, quickened well to snatch victory close to home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 起步時受緊迫，居後列，走內欄，留力候上。一百五十米處在靠近跑道中央位置望空。末段加速良佳，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W3W3W) Moderately away, raced 3 wide better than midfield, no cover throughout, a bit closer turning in, peaked on run 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走第三疊。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時略為追近。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W1W) Held up last, briefly hampered against rail 1400m out, some headway middle stages, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W1W) 留居包尾位置。千四米處沿欄競跑時一度受阻礙。中段略為追前。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W3W3W) Crowded shortly after start, raced towards rear on the outside, 4 lengths or so back turning in, made some progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W3W3W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後約四個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W4W) Settled in front of midfield 2 wide, made some late headway.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W4W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 12 shifted behind runners, settled at the back of the field 8-9Ls off pace in the first half of the race, ran on only fairly through final 300M. (No Vet findings.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第十二檔出閘後在馬群之後切入，前半程留居後列，落後領放馬八至九個馬位。最後三百米走勢僅屬一般。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W4W) From draw 1 moved up to race in 5th, always close enough to leaders, shifted out from fence passing 500M, ran on well final 300M to take 3rd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W4W) 自第一檔出閘後上前，居第五位，沿途保持落後領先馬匹不遠。跑過五百米處時移離內欄。最後三百米走勢良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (3W3W) Dropped out from widest draw, still in last place top of home straight, ran on well final 200m, tight for room close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(3W3W) 自最外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居包尾位置。最後二百米以佳勢上前。接近終點時受緊迫。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W2W2W3W) From draw 1 obtained running in midfield, switched to 2-wide 1100M, driven 400M out, ran on strongly down outside to get up close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W2W2W3W) 自第一檔出閘後居中間位置。千一米處移至第二疊。四百米處受催策。末段沿外疊以勁勢上前，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W2W) Waited with in rear, still in rear top of home straight, followed winner through 200m out, ran on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W2W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初仍居後列。二百米處跟隨頭馬上前。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Settled just off the pace in 3rd on rail, became 4th in a similar position 700M out, commenced move on home bend 500M out stalking the leader into straight, gained upper hand under pressure 100M out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬稍後的第三位，走內欄。七百米處居相若的第四位。五百米處直路彎開始上前，入直路時跟隨領放馬。一百米處在催策下佔得上風。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W4W) Waited with towards rear, pushed along wide into home straight, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W4W) 居後列，留力候上。入直路時受推策，走外疊。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W2W2W) From a middle draw obtained running in midfield 3-4Ls off the fast pace, had no clear running early straight, crowded near 200M and didn't run on thereafter. (No Vet findings.)
