runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W2W2W) 自第六檔出閘，居中間位置，在快步速下落後三至四個馬位。直路早段未能望空。接近二百米處時受擠迫，其後未能上前。（賽後接受獸醫檢查，並無發現任何明顯異常之處。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(+) (1W1W1W1W) Set slow pace first half of the race, was taken on by rival from 800M, battled hard on straightening, lost lead nearing 200M and weakened late stages. Held on for 4th just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(+)(1W1W1W1W) 賽事前半程以慢步速領放。自八百米處起受對手挑戰。入直路時力拼。接近二百米處時失去領先位置。末段轉弱，僅能保住第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Not the quickest out, ridden along to lead, travelled comfortably, kept on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 出閘並非最快，受催策，取得領先。走勢暢順。末段保持佳勢，掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (5W4W3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, pushed along 600m out to chase leaders, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(5W4W3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow(-) (1W1W2W3W) Raced in a handy spot behind leaders, well placed to strike 400M, fought well to wrestle the lead 100M out, all out final stages just couldn't hold off winner near line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速(-)(1W1W2W3W) 居領先馬匹之後的好位。四百米處居有利爭勝位置。一百米處以佳勢爭奪領先。末段力拼，僅於接近終點時未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Raced in touch with leaders, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ridden top of home straight, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領先馬匹。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。直路初受催策。其後保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W2W) Sat on pace, unable to quickened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 居前列。直路上未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W1W) From draw 3 raced just behind leaders throughout, fought hard to stay in contention from 300M, couldn't accelerate enough final 150M and made no further impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第三檔出閘，沿途居領先馬匹稍後位置。自三百米處起力拼以保持爭逐機會。最後一百五十米加速力不足，再無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Stayed close enough behind leaders, moved up to challenge 400M, badly crowded between rivals 150M before fading away over concluding stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。四百米處上前展開挑戰。一百五十米處在馬匹之間嚴重受擠迫。末段力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, ridden along 500m out, headed 300m out, dropped away quickly final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。五百米處受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W2W2W) Away on terms, moved up to be tracking the pace on outside, kept up the chase on leader turning home, fought hard but was held by first two late stage. Hung on for 3rd just.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W2W2W) 與對手同步出閘，上前跟隨領放馬，走外疊。入直路時持續追趕領放馬，但末段未能追上頭兩名馬匹。僅保住季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Ended up racing in midfield along the 3-path, soon left behind on straightening and finished tailed out. (Jockey - failed to show sufficient pace to go forward as instructed due to the ""Soft"" track conditions.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。入直路時瞬即被拋離，大敗而回。（騎師表示，由於「軟地」的場地狀況，坐騎未能展現足夠前速以如指示般上前。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped leaving stalls, rail position in mid-field, ridden along 350m out, stayed on but unable to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 出閘時與對手互相碰撞，居中間位置，走內欄。三百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Sat off pace on the rail, weakened final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 居領放馬之後，走內欄。最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Jumped awkwardly and lost ground, raced in second half of the field 8Ls off leader, kept on same pace in the straight and never able to trouble leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘笨拙及失地，居後半馬群中，落後領放馬八個馬位。直路上保持同速。從未能威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, settled in 5th positioned in second half of the field throughout, kept on same pace in the straight posing little threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般。沿途居後半馬群的第五位。直路上保持同速，對領先馬匹威脅不大。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Never better than mid-division of the small field, commenced move from over 2L back in 5th into straight but unable to make any impression throughout.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 在九駒中從未超越中間位置。入直路時從落後逾兩個馬位的第五位開始發力，但末段全程毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide, nothing extra in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路上再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (1W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, still in rear top of home straight, unable to reach leaders,
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(1W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。直路初仍居後列。未能追上領先馬匹。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, short of room top of home straight, checked 300m out, ran on well final 200m to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間之後位置。直路初空位不足。三百米處勒避。最後二百米以佳勢追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Bumped shortly after start, raced 2 wide behind midfield, a bit closer on turn, kept on well in straight to make frame.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。直路彎略為追近。直路上保持佳勢，取得第四名。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) From draw 1 obtained a position just ahead of midfield, close enough to leaders turning for home, fought on well to gain lead near 150M, couldn't hold off winner late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 自第一檔出閘，居中間稍前位置。轉入直路時緊隨領先馬匹。以佳勢力拼，接近一百五十米處時取得領先。末段未能抗衡頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 2 wide at rear, 5 to 6 lengths back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, checked near 250M, kept on same pace to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘稍慢及受擠迫，居後列，走第二疊。入直路時落後五至六個馬位。直路初對催策反應平平。接近二百五十米處時勒避。保持同速至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Began only fairly from gate 1, raced towards rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, made good progress early in straight, peaked 150M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘僅屬一般，居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初追前甚多。一百五十米處未能再加速。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, race keenly throughout, headway on bend to follow winner through 600m out, challenged and every chance from 400m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沿途搶口。直路彎上前，六百米處跟隨頭馬推進。自四百米處起展開挑戰，一度甚具爭勝機會。在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (1W3W) Dropped out in rail position from wide draw, pushed along wide for clear run 500m out, quickened early in home straight, hung in but strong run to lead 200m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(1W3W) 自外檔出閘後墮後，走內欄。五百米處受推策以望空，走外疊。直路早段加速，內閃，但走勢強勁，二百米處取得領先，帶返終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Shifted out at start, raced better than midfield on the outside, no cover throughout, moved a bit closer turning in, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 起步時向外斜跑，居中間之前位置，走外疊，沿途沒有遮擋。轉入直路時略為追近。二百五十米處取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Crowded start, raced at tail, 6 lengths or so back in the middle stages, made some progress final 400M. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時受擠迫，居包尾位置。中段落後約六個馬位。最後四百米略為追前。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Settled in mid-field, taken wider into home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。入直路時被帶出較外疊。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, without cover halfway out, taken wider on bend, eased 350m out when jockey was concerned with his action.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。半程時沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。三百五十米處在騎師對坐騎的動作有疑慮之際收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat midfield 2 wide, made good ground early part of the Straight, just one pace late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。直路早段追前甚多，但末段僅能保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W4W) Caught 3 wide no cover midfield, one pace when asked.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。末段在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W2W2W) Crowded on jumping from a wide draw then taken back to race at the rear, ran on fairly without threat to the leaders. Had difficulty obtaining clear running near 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W2W2W) 自外檔出閘時受擠迫，其後留居後列。走勢一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。接近一百米處時難以望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, made up some late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。末段略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W2W3W) Settled well back from a wide barrier and waited with, ran on in home straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，遙居於後，留力候上。直路上追前，以末段最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Taken back from a wide draw, raced 2 wide at rear, found rail 550M, 7 lengths back turning in, made some headway in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自外檔出閘，留居後列，走第二疊。五百五十米處移入內欄。轉入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Shifted in, bumped and lost balance out of stalls, raced in rear of mid-field, effort 500m out, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞及失去平衡。居中間之後位置。五百米處發力上前。遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W2W) Chased leader, challenged and improved to lead top of home straight, soon headed by winner 250m out, faded final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W2W) 追趕領放馬。直路初展開挑戰及上前取得領先。二百五十米處瞬即被頭馬超越。最後一百米力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, rail position in rear of mid-field, driven on bend, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久發生碰撞，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) In last few to straight, never nearer.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 直路前居最後數位之內。以末段最為接近。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Tarzino from Epona, a daughter of Makfi. Horses by the same sire include Sure Joyful and High Praise. This fellow had three starts for one win (a maiden over 1300m) and one placing. He was given three trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat not far behind the pace and finished eighth under slight pressure, beaten by 6-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「大捷龍」(Tarzino)之後，在港同父馬包括「得意佳作」及「高度評價」等駒，生母出自「馬勁飛」(Makfi)。來港前在紐西蘭三戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1300米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後試閘三次。最近10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段落後領先馬匹不遠，末段稍騎下跑第八名，落後頭馬6.25個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Commenced well, raced 2 wide better than midfield, steadied near 600M, wider turning in, no clear run early in straight, one-paced thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近六百米處時收慢。入直路時走更外疊。直路初未能望空，其後保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Three wide early stages, improved to tracked leaders 800m out, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, stayed on steadily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 早段走第三疊。八百米處推進以跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處受推策以追趕領先馬匹。末段保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear, unable to secure clear run until 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。未能望空直至三百五十米處，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field without cover, pushed along to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。五百米處受推策，追趕領先馬匹。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Settled in rear of mid-field, tight for room top of home straight, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之後位置。直路初受緊迫。走勢良佳，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) From a wide draw slotted into a 2-wide spot in midfield, brought wide 400M to challenge, finished off best final 200M to take 3rd close home. Nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，居中間位置，走第二疊。四百米處移出外疊以展開挑戰。最後二百米衝刺最佳，接近終點時取得第三名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover in midfield in the early and middle stages, moved up to join leaders passing 600M, hit lead 300M out but proved no match for winner from mid-straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 早段及中段居中間位置，走外疊，沒有遮擋。上前，跑過六百米處時追上領先馬匹。三百米處取得領先，但自直路中段起不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Made contact at start, raced 2 wide in midfield, 3 lengths or so back turning in, no clear run until approaching 100M, made good progress thereafter to take a place.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後約三個馬位。未能望空直至趨近一百米處，其後追前頗多，跑入季席。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W3W) Out in line, raced 2 wide in midfield, 6 lengths back turning in, made some progress in straight to take 2nd, no threat to the winner. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間位置，走第二疊。入直路時落後六個馬位。直路上略為追前，跑入亞席，但未能威脅頭馬。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Soon recovered from moderate start to just over 3L back in 6th on rail, gained 5th in a similar rail position on home bend about 750M out, not much room in straight until over 300M out, quickened well to take charge at the 150M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，瞬即恢復走勢，居第六位，落後稍逾三個馬位，走內欄。約七百五十米處於直路彎進佔第五位，居相若位置，仍走內欄。直路上空位不足直至三百米處。以佳勢加速，一百五十米處取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away with them, tracked leaders on the inside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed good response in straight, took the lead 50M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 與對手同步躍出，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路上對催策反應良佳，五十米處取得領先。保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W4W) Began only fairly, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, there to turn, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路上略為追前。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Universal Ruler, who also sired Macanese Master, from Full Time, a daughter of Blackfriars. This fellow had two starts for two wins (a 3yo+ maiden over 1200m and a 3yo+ handicap over 1300m). He was given five trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He shared the lead and finished third under pressure, beaten by 3/4L, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 23. In the latest trial, he sat behind midfield and finished fifth under slight pressure, beaten by about 3Ls, over 1050m AWT at Sha Tin on November 3. He’s probably not looking like a first-up winner but this race will give us a chance to look at him more closely.
formguide.comments_chi: 「環球霸主」(Universal Ruler)之後，另一匹在港同父馬為「銀亮濠俠」，生母出自Blackfriars。來港前在澳洲兩戰全勝，頭馬包括一場1200米三歲及以上從未勝出馬賽，及一場1300米三歲及以上讓磅賽。抵港後五次試閘兩次上名。10月23日出試從化草地1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬0.75個馬位。最近11月3日出試田泥1050米，早段居中間之後位置，末段稍騎下跑第五名，落後頭馬約三個馬位。不似能一出即勝，觀望為宜。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden along 700m out, outpaced and left behind final 250m, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策。最後二百五十米未能跟上步速，被拋離。落後甚遠時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W2W3W) Fast break, outpaced and settled in mid-field, unable to hold position on bend, switched wide for clear run 150m out, ran on strongly final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W2W3W) 出閘迅速。未能跟上步速，居中間位置。直路彎未能保持位置。一百五十米處移出外疊以望空。最後一百米衝刺強勁。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W2W2W3W) Pressed forward from a wide barrier before shifting in for cover in 3L 4th onto first bend, further off the lead in increased tempo in back straight, renewed effort over 400M out and hit the front 200M out, just held on to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W2W2W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。開始轉首個彎位時向內移入以取得遮擋，居第四位，落後三個馬位。對面直路上步速加快時落後領放馬更遠。四百米處重新發力。二百米處取得領先，終點線上僅勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, under pressure 600m out, dropped away quickly in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。六百米處受催策。直路上迅速墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 500m out, stayed on but lacked pace to reach leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百米處轉換跑線以望空。保持走勢，但速度不足以追及領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Up with early pace before easing back to race ahead of midfield, had some difficulty obtaining clear running 300M-200M then attacked the line well to be nearest at the finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 早段跟上前速，其後收慢留居中間之前位置。三百米處至二百米處之間頗為難以望空，其後以佳勢衝刺。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Blundered on jumping, chased leaders in 3rd, driven along 400M and moved up to 2nd nearing 200M, couldn't get closer to the winner final stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 躍出時失蹄。追趕領先馬匹，居第三位。四百米處受催策，接近二百米處時上前進佔第二位。末段未能追近頭馬。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Shamus Award from Kentucky Tornado, a daughter of Mizzen Mast. Horses by the same sire include Bottomuptogether and Rising From Ashes. This fellow had five starts for one win (a maiden over 1400m) and two placings. He was given four trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He raced handily and finished third, beaten by 1-1/4Ls, under pressure over 1200m on turf in Conghua on September 21. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished fourth under slight pressure, beaten by 1-3/4Ls, over 1200m on turf in Conghua on October 12. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: 「夏姆斯獎」(Shamus Award)之後，在港同父馬包括「天天同樂」及「自力更生」等駒，生母出自Mizzen Mast。來港前在澳洲五戰得一勝兩位，頭馬為一場1400米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘一次上名。9月21日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第三名，落後頭馬1.25個馬位。最近10月12日出試從化草地1200米，早段居前競跑，末段稍騎下跑第四名，落後頭馬1.75個馬位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Made contact at start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, no daylight early in straight, showed limited response after passing 200M, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。跑過二百米處後對催策反應平平，最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Slow into stride from gate 4, ridden along early to be handy on the fence, briefly held up in the home straight, once clear picked up well to score by a narrow margin.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第四檔出閘緩慢。早段受催策，居前列，走內欄。直路上一度受困，望空後隨即加速良佳，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W1W) In rear after hampered leaving stalls, had to wait for run early in home straight, clear 300m out, stayed on at the one pace.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W1W) 出閘時受阻礙，其後居後列。直路早段須等待空位出現。三百米處望空。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W3W) Slightly slow out settling in last few, bumped 400M out upon straightening, ran on steadily but unable to sustain effort close to finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W3W) 出閘稍慢，居最後數位之內。入直路時於四百米處與對手互相碰撞。末段穩步上前，但接近終點時無以為繼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, strong run to lead 150m out, on top from there, won cosily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置。走勢強勁，一百五十米處取得領先。其後保持領先，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, held up last, detached throughout, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後，留居包尾位置。沿途被拋離。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W1W) Sluggish at start, soon made good headway on rail to rear of midfield in 7th, saved ground turning in for home, one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W1W) 起步緩慢，瞬即沿欄追前頗多，居中間之後第七位。轉入直路時走內疊節省腳程。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W1W1W) Hampered 1300M out, settled behind midfield on rail, came under pressure home bend, steadied between runners 250M out, ran home one-paced.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W1W1W) 千三米處受阻礙，居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路彎受催策。二百五十米處在馬匹之間收慢。末段保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Raced in rear after crowded at start, lost balance 1000m out, dropped to last place top of home straight, no impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步時受擠迫，其後居後列。一千米處失去平衡。直路初墮居包尾位置。毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, didn't quite have speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Jumped well, raced 3 wide slightly better than midfield, travelled keenly in the middle stages, 1 to 2 lengths back turning in, kept on well in straight to take 2nd without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 出閘迅速，居中間稍前位置，走第三疊。中段搶口。入直路時落後一至兩個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，跑獲亞軍，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, pressed in front, disputed led final bend, headed top of home straight, gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。在領放下受追迫。直路彎爭奪領先。直路初被超越。最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W3W) From draw 3 obtained a 2-wide position ahead of midfield, urged along nearing 400M, ran home only fairly under pressure posing o threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W3W) 自第三檔出閘，居中間之前位置，走第二疊。接近四百米處時受催策。末段在催策下走勢僅屬一般，未能對領先馬匹構成威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Jumped with them, raced prominently, 2 wide, positioned 1 out 1 back on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened gradually inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 與對手同步躍出，居前列，走第二疊。直路彎居第二疊第二位。直路初未能再增速。最後二百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W2W) Prominent, quickened early in home straight to lead 300m out, stayed on well and in control final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W2W) 居前列。直路初加速，三百米處取得領先。保持佳勢，最後一百米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, unable to quicken over 300m out, stuck to task, lacked speed to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。三百米處未能加速。持續力拼，但速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Box seat, under pressure 700m out to chase leaders, outpaced and gave ground final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居包廂位置。七百米處在催策下追趕領先馬匹。未能跟上步速，最後二百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Began only fairly, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, made minor progress early in straight, peaked 150M, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。直路初略為追前。一百五十米處未能再增速。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (5W3W3W) Three wide in rear without cover, some headway on bend, sustained headway in home straight, not beaten far.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(5W3W3W) 居後列，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。直路上持續追前。所負不遠。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W2W) Jumped only fairly, raced better than midfield on the inside, 2 wide turning in, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W2W) 出閘僅屬一般，居中間之前位置，走內疊。入直路時走第二疊。末段衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, challenged the leader turning in, hit the front approaching 300M, kept on well but unable to hold off the first two final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時挑戰領放馬。趨近三百米處時取得領先。保持佳勢，但最後五十米不敵首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Began well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。衝刺強勁，以一頸位之先掄元。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W4W) Mid-field, pushed along on bend to hold position, headway when checked briefly 250m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W4W) 居中間位置。直路彎受推策以保持位置。追前，二百五十米處一度勒避。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W3W) Settled in mid-field, under pressure 550m out, stayed on but never going pace to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W3W) 居中間位置。五百五十米處受催策。保持走勢，但從未能加速以威脅領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Ridden along from widest draw to get across, headed top of home straight, stuck to task, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 自最外檔出閘後受催策，切入內疊。直路初被超越。持續力拼。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W1W) Made running, ridden top of home straight, headed 300m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W1W) 領放。直路初受催策。三百米處被超越。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, showed limited response early in straight, bumped near 200M, weakened thereafter.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段對催策反應平平。接近二百米處時被碰撞，其後轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W4W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, taken wider on bend, gave ground final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W4W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎移出更外疊。最後三百米墮退。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Obtained a midfield position along the fence, raced keenly when pace steadied after 800M, lacked a finishing response in the straight and never able to challenge leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間位置，走內欄。過了八百米處後在步速減慢時搶口。直路上在催策下衝刺乏力。從未能挑戰領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W5W) Ran out of room and bumped after leaving the stalls, went back to be 2nd last soon after, swung for home to be the widest, produced some minor progress in the final stages, crying out for a longer trip.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W5W) 出閘後空位不足及發生碰撞，其後迅即墮居尾二位置。入直路時移出最外疊。末段略為追前。適合增程角逐。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Rail position in rear, had to wait for run turning into home straight, ridden along 300m out, strong run to lead 100m out, on top from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 居後列，走內欄。轉入直路時須等待空位出現。三百米處受催策。衝刺強勁，一百米處帶頭。其後保持領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Settled in mid-field, ridden top of home straight, checked 350m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居中間位置。直路初受催策。三百五十米處勒避。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Moderately away, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made no progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘普通，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上毫無進展。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with towards rear, briefly hampered 500m out, lost touch in home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。五百米處一度受阻礙。直路上被拋離。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Made all, set strong pace, kicked 300m out, stayed on well, in control final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 沿途以快步速領放。三百米處加速。保持佳勢，最後五十米控制大局。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Made running, travelled smoothly, asserted from over 200m out under largely hand riding, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 帶頭，走勢暢順。自二百米處起大多受推策，控制大局。從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Ridden along early to lead, weakened in the Straight. (Barrier Manners and Performance Unacceptable)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 早段在催策下領先。直路上轉弱。（閘廂行為及表現均難以接受。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 400m out, joined by rival 200m out, quickened again and won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。四百米處加速。二百米處被對手追及，再度加速，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, stayed on but unable to match front two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。入直路時走勢暢順。末段保持走勢，但未能抗衡首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (4W1W) Settled in rear of mid-field, under pressure 550m out, unable to secure clear run until 300m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(4W1W) 居中間之後位置。五百五十米處受催策。未能望空直至三百米處。末段保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, taken wider on bend, ran on well, shifted in close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W3W) 緊隨領先馬匹。直路彎移出更外疊。以佳勢上前，接近終點時向內斜跑。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Led early, headed 1000m out, remained prominent, under pressure to chase leaders 500m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 早段領放。一千米處被超越，仍居前列。五百米處受催策，追趕領先馬匹。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Moderately away from gate 1, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept on well early in straight, peaked 200M, weakened thereafter. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘普通，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段保持佳勢。二百米處未能再增速，其後轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W1W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, raced in touch with leaders, effort top of home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W1W) 出閘時向內斜跑及發生碰撞，跟隨領先馬匹。直路初發力，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Good; (4W3W) Shifted in and bumped leaving stalls, ridden along from stalls to track pace without cover, effort 500m out, no extra final 200m.
(Jockey dropped whip at 200M.)
(Sustained a minor abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a minor abrasion to the left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
中等步速;(4W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，其後受催策跟隨領先馬匹，沒有遮擋。五百米處受催策。最後二百米再無餘力。
（於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭失以及失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）
（左前腿輕微擦傷。）
runnerrecords.incident_chi: （於二百米處騎師跌掉馬鞭失以及失去右前蹄的蹄鐵。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W1W) Showed good speed to lead, quickened early in home straight and soon in command, kicked two lengths clear 200m out, won going away.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W1W) 展現甚快前速領放。直路初加速，瞬即控制大局。二百米處加速帶離兩個馬位，帶離對手勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Ridden along to lead, weakened passing 150M (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 受催策上前領放。跑過一百五十米處時轉弱。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W2W) Jumped cleanly from draw 1, restrained to race in midfield along the fence, switched out 400M to challenge but unable to make any impression.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W2W) 自第一檔出閘俐落，受約束，居中間位置，走內欄。四百米處向外移出以展開挑戰，但毫無表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (4W3W4W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well to close on leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(4W3W4W) 自外檔出閘後留後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。以佳勢上前，追近領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Ridden along the rail to be up with the pace before settling one back in 3rd on rail inside the 700M, soon came to tackle leaders on straightening holding every chance despite tight run 150M out and only to be denied narrowly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 沿欄受催策，跟隨領放馬。七百米處居第三位，落後一個馬位，走內欄。入直路時瞬即追趕領先馬匹，儘管一百五十米處緊迫競跑，但已獲機會盡展所長。僅以短距離落敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W1W) Sent forward to lead, weakened in the Straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W1W) 受催策上前領放。直路上轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Sat in front of midfield 2 wide, nothing extra.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 居中間之前位置，走第二疊。末段再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, showed good speed to lead, ridden 300m out, headed 100m out and faded.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，展現甚快前速領放。三百米處受催策。一百米處被超越，力竭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (4W3W3W) Caught racing wide no cover behind the pacesetters, fought hard to stay in contention early straight, lacked the extra from 200M and was only battling from there.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(4W3W3W) 居領先馬匹之後，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初力拼以保持爭勝機會。自二百米處起再無餘力，僅能勉力而為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Rail position in mid-field, checked 350m out, stayed on but never going pace to get competitive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 居中間位置，走內欄。三百五十米處勒避。保持走勢，但從未能加速以爭勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (4W2W2W) Wide early, dropped to settle in rear of mid-field with cover 800m out, ridden top of home straight, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(4W2W2W) 早段走外疊。八百米處墮居中間之後位置，有遮擋。直路初受催策，但未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Taken back to race behind midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, angled out 450M, finished off evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 留居中間之後位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。四百五十米處向外移出。末段以穩勢衝刺。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, positioned 1-1/4L behind the leader, saved ground on turn, peaked early in straight, weakened final 250M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，落後領放馬一又四分一個馬位。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能再增速。最後二百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Settled in mid-field, driven along 700m out, unable to improve position, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 居中間位置。七百米處受催策。其後未能推進上前，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W3W) Jumped ok and settled midfield one off the rail, angled out for a run 600M out, lacked a finishing effort and outsprinted (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W3W) 出閘尚可，居中間位置，走第二疊。六百米處向外移出以取位。衝刺乏力，被超越。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; In rear after sluggish start, switched towards centre of course for clear run 300m out, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步緩慢，居後列。三百米處移向跑道中央以望空。在催策下保持同速。

formguide.comments_eng: New Zealand PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Time Test from Lady Muskwa, a daughter of Per Incanto. Horses by the same sire include Mighty Strength and Family Jewel. This fellow had one start for one win (a maiden over 1235m). He was given four trials for one win in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he shared the lead and won by 1L under pressure, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He will probably need a run.
formguide.comments_chi: 「歲月洗禮」(Time Test)之後，在港同父馬包括「勁大威猛」及「共享富裕」等駒，生母出自Per Incanto。來港前在澳洲一出一捷，頭馬為一場1235米從未勝出馬賽。抵港後四次試閘得一勝。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段並頭領放，末段力策下以一個馬位之先勝出。首戰熱身為主。

formguide.comments_eng: Australian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Street Boss from Palurien, a daughter of Reset. Horses by the same sire include Sturdy Ruby and King Of Fighters. This fellow had two starts for one win (a 3yo maiden over 1200m) and one placing. He was given two trials for one placing in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished second, beaten by 1L, under slight pressure over 1000m on turf at Sha Tin on October 13. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 2-1/2Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 27. He looks like a player here at the first time of asking.
formguide.comments_chi: Street Boss之後，在港同父馬包括「紅海勁」及「佛亮老撾」等駒，生母出自Reset。來港前在澳洲兩戰得一勝一位，頭馬為一場1200米三歲從未勝出馬賽。抵港後兩次試閘一次上名。10月13日出試田草1000米，早段居中，末段稍騎下跑第二名，落後頭馬一個馬位。最近10月27日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬2.5個馬位。初出有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Bumped start, raced in midfield on the stands' rail, moved a bit closer in the middle stages, hard ridden after passing 300M but only showed limited response, weakened gradually final 50M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步時被碰撞，居中間位置，走外欄。中段略為追近。跑過三百米處後受力策，但反應僅屬平平。最後五十米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; Became unbalanced after the start, showed pace on his debut to be racing close up behind leaders, fought on steadily final 300M to finish a pleasing 3rd on debut.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;起步後失去平衡。今仗初出展現前速，緊隨領先馬匹。最後三百米持續力拼，跑獲季軍，首戰表現令人滿意。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; Missed the start, sat last, detached, made late ground.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;漏閘，居包尾位置，被馬群拋離。末段追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Waited with in rear, switched wide on bend, unable to pick up for pressure from 400m out.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 居後列，留力候上。直路彎移出外疊。自四百米處起在催策下未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W3W) Made contact shortly after start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out after passing 500M, showed limited response early in straight, weakened gradually final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W3W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，居中間位置，走第二疊。跑過五百米處後向外移出。直路早段對催策反應平平。最後一百米逐漸轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W2W2W) Settled in rear of mid-field, pushed along to hold position from 600m out, lacked pace to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W2W2W) 居中間之後位置。自六百米處起受推策以保持位置。速度不足以展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Settled behind midfield on the rail, ran on okay.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。走勢尚可。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W3W) Sat midfield 2 wide, held up and never seriously tested.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊。受困，從未能真正施為。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (1W3W) Ridden along early to be 3 back the rail, travelled cozily in the run, moved off the fence 550m out, shifted back in for more racing room final stages and only stayed the same pace thereafter (See Incident Report).
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(1W3W) 早段受催策，落後三個馬位，走內欄。沿途走勢暢順。五百五十米處移離內欄。末段向內移回以取得更多競賽空間，其後僅保持同速。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Held up last, switched and followed winner through 300m out, ran on well to close on winner but always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 留居包尾位置。三百米處轉換跑線，跟隨頭馬上前。以佳勢上前，追近頭馬，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, settled in rear of mid-field, dropped away quickly in home straight, eased once well held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘時向內斜跑及被碰撞，居中間之後位置。直路上迅速墮退，遙遙落後時隨即收慢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W5W) Shifted out at start and made heavy contact, raced at rear throughout, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W5W) 起步時向外斜跑，與對手互相大力觸碰。沿途居後列。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Fast; (2W3W3W5W) Began well from a poor draw but soon taken back to midfield 3-wide without cover before first turn, shuffled backward to 6.5L back in 7th in slackened tempo on the first bend, switched wide into straight but unable to quicken.
(Lame in left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
快步速;(2W3W3W5W) 自外檔出閘迅速，瞬即留居中間位置，首個彎位前走第三疊，沒有遮擋。首個彎位步速減慢時墮居第七位，落後六個半馬位。入直路時移出外疊，但未能加速。
（左前腿不良於行。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W3W) Settled in midfield on rail, switched off rail approaching home turn over 500M out but baulked in straight until inside the 200M, finished off the race well to snatch race final strides.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W3W) 居中間位置，走內欄。五百米處趨近直路彎時移離內欄，但直路上受困直至二百米處。衝刺良佳，最後數步取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (2W3W) Settled on pace 2 wide, badly crowded near 350M, kept on evenly.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(2W3W) 居前列，走第二疊。接近三百五十米處時受嚴重擠迫。保持穩勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (2W4W) Crowded after the start, settled down in midfield, steadied 650M, wide into straight before running on nicely for 3rd under a big weight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(2W4W) 起步後受擠迫，居中間位置。六百五十米處收慢。入直路時走外疊，在負重磅下走勢良佳，跑獲季軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (2W2W2W3W) Settled midfield 2 wide with cover, driven out rounding the turn, stayed on well to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(2W2W2W3W) 居中間位置，走第二疊，有遮擋。轉直路彎時受力策。保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Tracked leader, challenged under pressure from 300m out, responded well and on top final 50m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。自三百米處起在催策下展開挑戰。最後五十米對催策反應良佳，取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (2W2W) Mid-field, good headway under pressure from 400m out, led 100m out and responded well to hold off runner-up.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(2W2W) 居中間位置。自四百米處起在催策下追前甚多。一百米處取得領先。其後對催策反應良佳，力拒亞軍馬匹的挑戰勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Pressed leader, ridden along to chase leader 350m out, one paced and unable to get on terms with leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百五十米處受催策以追趕領放馬。保持同速，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, kept to inside after straightening and made minor progress.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。入直路後保持走內疊，略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Away well, raced in midfield on the outside, 2 lengths or so back turning in, showed limited response early in straight, weakened inside final furlong.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居中間位置，走外疊。入直路時落後約兩個馬位。直路早段對催策反應平平，最後二百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Began well from gate 1, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, unable to obtain clear run in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘迅速，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路上未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (3W2W2W) Dropped out from wide draw, pushed along wide into home straight, unable to pick up for pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(3W2W2W) 自外檔出閘後墮後。入直路時受推策，走外疊。末段受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Raced in touch with leaders, switched for clear run 550m out, flattened out final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 跟隨領先馬匹。五百五十米處轉換跑線以望空。最後二百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Pressed leader, pushed along to chase leader 500m out, weakened quickly home straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。五百米處受推策以追趕領放馬。直路上迅速轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground and settling well behind, tight 300M out and switched out for a run 200M out, produced good late impression closing stages.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 出閘笨拙，失地，遙居於後。三百米處受緊迫。二百米處向外移出以取位。末段追前頗多。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Bumped start, taken back to race towards rear on the outside, 7 lengths back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後七個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, held up behind midfield, swung wide from 500M, kept on steadily to the line without posing serious threat to leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置。自五百米處起移出外疊。保持穩勢至終點，未能對領先馬匹構成真正威脅。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow; (3W4W) Out with rest, raced slightly better than midfield, no cover throughout, 1-3/4L back turning in, finished off very strongly, led close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速;(3W4W) 與對手同步躍出，居中間稍前位置。沿途沒有遮擋。入直路時落後一又四分三馬位。衝刺凌厲，接近終點時取得領先。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W3W) Began awkwardly losing ground, soon recovered to just worse than midfield mostly in 9th on rail, travelled keenly home bend and forced to steady 600M out, not much room early in straight, obtained a clear run 260M out, did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W3W) 出閘笨拙及失地，瞬即恢復走勢，大多居中間稍後的第九位，走內欄。直路彎搶口，六百米處被迫收慢。直路早段空位不足，二百六十米處望空，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W4W) Bumped start, raced 2 wide in midfield, angled out 500M, 6 lengths or so back turning in, finished off well to take 2nd.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W4W) 起步時發生碰撞，居中間位置，走第二疊。五百米處向外移出。入直路時落後約六個馬位。末段衝刺良佳，跑獲亞軍。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (2W2W) Taken back from the widest draw, raced at rear on the outside, 6 lengths or so back turning in, made very good progress in straight to make frame, nearest finish.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(2W2W) 自最外檔出閘，留居後列競跑，走外疊。入直路時落後約六個馬位。直路上追前甚多，取得第四名。過終點時最為接近。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W3W) Tracked pace out wide without cover, ridden top of home straight, ran on well and just failed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W3W) 跟隨領放馬，走外疊，沒有遮擋。直路初受催策。以佳勢追前，僅敗。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast(+) (3W4W) Began awkwardly, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths back, same margin back turning in, finished off very strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速(+)(3W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，落後四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。入直路時落後相同距離。末段衝刺凌厲，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Pressed leader, under pressure and led narrowly 300m out, headed by winner 150m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 追迫領放馬。三百米處受催策，以短距離領先。一百五十米處被頭馬超越，持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) First few away from barrier 7 and sat prominent one off, exerted his authority when asked for an effort 300M out, ran straight past the leader and held the rest at bay, smart prospect.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 自第七檔出閘，為出閘最快數駒之一，居前列，走第二疊。三百米處在催策下控制大局，隨即超越領放馬，帶離對手至終點。前途光明。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (2W2W) Fast into stride, sent forward to take the lead, 2 wide, led by 1/2L turning in, hard ridden from 250M, finished off very strongly, really impressive.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(2W2W) 展步迅速，受催策上前，取得領先，走第二疊。入直路時領先半個馬位。自二百五十米處起受力策。衝刺凌厲，以漂亮姿態勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Jumped awkwardly, taken back to race behind midfield on the outside, moved a bit closer on turn, 3-1/2L back turning in, showed very good response in straight, hit the front 200M, kept on strongly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 出閘笨拙，留居中間之後位置，走外疊。直路彎略為追近。入直路時落後三個半馬位。直路上對催策反應甚佳。二百米處取得領先。保持勁勢至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, taken back to race at tail, saved ground on turn, showed limited response early in straight, no clear run final 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留居包尾位置。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初對催策反應平平。最後一百米未能望空。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Jumped only fairly, held up, clear run up rail home straight, one paced under pressure, unable to challenge.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 出閘僅屬一般，留後。直路上沿欄望空。在催策下保持同速，未能展開挑戰。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Dropped out from widest draw, had to wait for run early in home straight, no extra final 200m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自大外檔出閘後墮後。直路早段須等待空位出現。最後二百米再無餘力。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Bumped shortly after leaving stalls, rear of mid-field, driven 500m out, briefly tight for room 300m out, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘後不久被碰撞，居中間之後位置。五百米處受催策。三百米處一度受緊迫。末段未能推進。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow(-) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared 200M, finished off strongly to snatch victory near the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速(-)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初未能望空。二百米處望空。衝刺強勁，接近終點時取得勝利。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W4W) Jumped awkwardly, raced 2 wide behind midfield, wider from 600M, 4 to 5 lengths back turning in, made no progress in straight. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W4W) 出閘笨拙，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。自六百米處起走較外疊。入直路時落後四至五個馬位。直路上毫無進展。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, challenged up rail early in home straight, stayed on but no match for leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初沿欄展開挑戰。保持走勢，但不敵領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (4W2W2W2W) Went forward chasing leader in a fast run race, was left without a finishing effort in the home straight, weakened to last.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(4W2W2W2W) 在快步速下上前追趕領放馬。直路上衝刺乏力。末段轉弱，包尾而回。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W) Chased leader, challenged strongly final 250M but winner found the necessary to hold on.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W) 追趕領放馬。最後二百五十米以勁勢展開挑戰，但頭馬猶有餘力保住勝果。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W1W1W) Had a ground saving trip from draw 2 and stayed close enough behind leaders throughout, kept on steadily when placed under pressure in the straight. Held by leaders.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 自第二檔出閘，走內疊節省腳程，沿途保持緊隨領先馬匹。直路上在催策下保持穩勢，未能追上領先馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W2W2W2W) Ridden along from stalls to get across, chased leader, driven along 500m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W2W2W2W) 出閘後受催策以切入內疊，追趕領放馬。五百米處受催策。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W2W2W) Jumped with them, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, finished off strongly to score by a neck.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W2W2W) 與對手同步躍出，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。衝刺強勁，以一馬頸位之先勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (1W1W1W1W) Stayed close to leaders throughout, pace very slow in early stages, worked into the race well, tried hard to reel in first two final 300M but was always held.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(1W1W1W1W) 沿途緊隨領先馬匹，早段步速非常緩慢。走勢良佳。最後三百米力拼以追及頭兩名馬匹，但一直落後。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (2W2W) Always prominent, hit the front briefly 300M out only to be caught at about the 100M.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(2W2W) 一直居前列。三百米處一度取得領先，僅於約一百米處被超越。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Tracked leaders against rail, twice short of room when trying to improve in home straight, unlucky.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 沿欄跟隨領先馬匹。直路上在嘗試推進之際兩度空位不足。際遇欠佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Shifted in and bumped out of stalls, raced in touch with leaders, tight for room early in home straight, weakened final 150m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘時向內斜跑，與對手互相碰撞，緊隨領先馬匹。直路初受緊迫。最後一百五十米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Jumped well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, a length back turning in, kept on well in straight without threatening the winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。入直路時落後一個馬位。直路上保持佳勢，但未能威脅頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W3W) Taken back from gate 9, raced towards rear on the outside, 5-1/4L back turning in, made minor progress in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W3W) 自第九檔出閘，留居後列，走外疊。入直路時落後五又四分一個馬位。直路上略為追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W2W) Disputed led, led from 1000m out, under pressure 350m out, headed by runner-up 300m out, flattened out final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W2W) 爭奪領先。自一千米處起領先。三百五十米處受催策。三百米處被亞軍馬匹超越。最後一百米洩氣。

runnerrecords.comments_eng:
Pace Very fast; (3W3W3W3W) Pressed forward from a poor draw before settling 3-wide just worse than midfield in 9th just under 8L off the pace, dropped out of contention rounding home bend from 750M out.
(Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.healthissue_eng: (Sustained a small cut to left front leg.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi:
極快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 自外檔出閘，受催策上前。其後居中間稍後的第九位，落後領放馬近八個馬位，走第三疊。自七百五十米處起轉直路彎時墮退，再無爭勝機會。
（左前腿輕微割傷。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very fast; (3W4W) Three wide in mid-field, ridden early in home straight, one paced under pressure.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極快步速;(3W4W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。直路早段受催策，在催策下保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (3W3W) Three wide in mid-field, followed winner through 400m out, ran on well final 200m but no match for winner.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(3W3W) 居中間位置，走第三疊。四百米處跟隨頭馬上前。最後二百米以佳勢上前，但不敵頭馬。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Waited with in rear, had to wait for run top of home straight, switched wide for clear run 250m out, ran on strongly close home.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 居後列，留力候上。直路初須等候空位出現。二百五十米處移出外疊以望空。接近終點時以勁勢追前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W4W) Settled at the back, quickened well inside final 200M and did best work late.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W4W) 居後列。最後二百米以佳勢加速上前，末段表現最佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Very slow; (3W2W) Raced 3-wide at the rear, unable to make up ground in the straight. (Jockey was advised he had made error of judgement by not improving position in early stages to avoid racing wide and without cover.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 極慢步速;(3W2W) 居後列，走第三疊。直路上未能追前。（小組告誡騎師，他於早段未有讓坐騎上前以免坐騎在沒有遮擋下走外疊屬判斷錯誤。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (2W3W) Dropped out from wide draw, held up last, still in last place top of home straight, switched for clear run 250m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(2W3W) 自外檔出閘，墮居包尾位置。直路初仍居包尾位置。二百五十米處向外移出以望空。保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast; (3W3W3W3W) Three wide in rear of mid-field without cover, some headway final bend, widest into home straight, never a factor.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速;(3W3W3W3W) 居中間之後位置，走第三疊，沒有遮擋。直路彎略為追前。入直路時走最外疊。從未有力一爭。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, ridden top of home straight, unable to quicken.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。直路初受催策，但未能加速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Crowded shortly after start, rail position in mid-field, pushed along on bend to maintain position, unable to improve position.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久受擠迫，居中間位置，走內欄。直路彎受推策以保持位置。末段未能推進上前。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (3W5W) Made contact at start, raced slightly behind midfield on the outside, 5 lengths back turning in, kept on same pace in straight.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(3W5W) 起步時發生觸碰，居中間稍後位置，走外疊。入直路時落後五個馬位。直路上保持同速。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Commenced well, raced better than midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, took the lead 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 出閘迅速，居中間之前位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。二百米處取得領先，保持佳勢至終點，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (2W3W) Began only fairly and made contact, raced 2 wide behind midfield, 3 wide turning in, finished off strongly to take 2nd, just beaten by a head.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(2W3W) 出閘僅屬一般，與對手互相觸碰，居中間之後位置，走第二疊。入直路時走第三疊，衝刺強勁，取得亞軍，僅以一馬頭位之差見負。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (1W1W) Taken back from gate 9, raced at rear on the inside, saved ground on turn, no clear run early in straight, cleared near 250M, closed off well to take a place without threatening the first two.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(1W1W) 自第九檔出閘後留居包尾位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路早段未能望空。接近二百五十米處時望空。末段以佳勢衝刺，跑入季席，但未能威脅首兩名馬匹。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to slow(-) (3W3W) Slightly slow out and crowded, raced 3 wide with cover behind midfield, 4 lengths or so back, same margin back on turn, made good progress in straight to take a place. (See Racing Incidents.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏慢步速(-)(3W3W) 出閘稍慢，受擠迫，居中間之後位置，落後約四個馬位，走第三疊，有遮擋。直路彎落後相同距離。直路上追前甚多，跑獲季軍。（見競賽事件報告。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) From draw 1 tracked leaders on inside but was held up for clear running over final 350M and not tested to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 自第一檔出閘，跟隨領先馬匹，走內疊，但最後三百五十米受困而未能望空。未能施為至終點。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(+) (1W2W) Rail position in rear of mid-field, travelled smoothly into home straight, under pressure 400m out, ran on well, promising.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(+)(1W2W) 居中間之後位置，走內欄。入直路時走勢暢順。四百米處受催策。末段以佳勢追前。表現不俗。

formguide.comments_eng: Argentine PP, a 5-year-old horse, by Daniel Boone from Magna Carta, a daughter of Catcher In The Rye. He will be the first runner of his sire in Hong Kong. This fellow had four starts for four wins (including a 3yo+ group one over 2400m). He was given two trials for two placings in Hong Kong. He sat midfield and finished second under pressure, beaten by a head, over 1200m AWT in Conghua on October 8. In the latest trial, he raced handily and finished second under pressure, beaten by a neck, over 1600m on turf in Conghua on October 23. Prefer to take a watching brief to see how he shapes at his local debut.
formguide.comments_chi: Daniel Boone之後，是此父系首匹在港上陣馬，生母出自Catcher In The Rye。來港前在阿根廷四戰全勝，頭馬包括一場2400米三歲及以上一級賽。抵港後兩次試閘全上名。10月8日出試從化泥地1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頭位。最近10月23日出試從化草地1600米，早段居前競跑，末段力策下跑第二名，落後頭馬一馬頸位。初出暫宜觀望。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast(-) (1W1W) Fast break, made running, pressed by rivals from 500m out, kicked 400m out, headed by winner 200m out, sticking to task.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速(-)(1W1W) 出閘迅速，領放。自五百米處起受對手追迫。四百米處加速。二百米處被頭馬超越。持續力拼。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (1W1W) Showed good speed to lead, kicked 350m out and ran on well, pressed by runner-up to line and just prevailed.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(1W1W) 展現甚快前速，取得領先。三百五十米處加速，以佳勢上前。被亞軍馬匹追迫至終點，險勝。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W1W) Showed great speed to lead, under pressure 400m out, headed 200m out, weakened final 100m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W1W) 前速甚快，取得領先。四百米處受催策。二百米處被超越。最後一百米轉弱。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W2W) Tracked leader, travelled strongly to lead early in home straight, pressed on 250m out, headed by winner 100m out, stayed on well.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W2W) 跟隨領放馬。直路初走勢強勁，取得領先。二百五十米處受催策。一百米處被頭馬超越，保持佳勢。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good to fast; (2W3W) Began well, positioned 1 out 1 back, there to turn, hit the front 250M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等偏快步速;(2W3W) 出閘迅速，居第二疊第二位。直路彎前居相同位置，二百五十米處取得領先，末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (1W2W) Away well to lead, set good pace in first half of the race, shifted away from running rail on straightening then kept on well only to be caught by first three in closing stages. (Riding tactics questioned.)
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(1W2W) 出閘迅速，領放。前半程以快步速領放。入直路時移離內欄，其後保持佳勢，僅於末段被三甲馬匹超越。（騎師被查詢競跑策略。）

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Commenced well, raced in 2nd, 2 wide, there to turn, challenged the leader early in straight, hit the front approaching 200M, kept on well to the line and scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘迅速，居第二位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。直路早段挑戰領放馬。趨近二百米處時取得領先。末段保持佳勢，勝出賽事。

formguide.comments_eng: Brazilian PP, a 4-year-old gelding, by Outstrip from Energia Halo, a daughter of Gloria de Campeao. Horses by the same sire include Outgate and Joyful Champion. This fellow had six starts for three wins (including a 3yo group one over 1600m) and three placings (including a 3yo group one over 1600m and another over 2000m). He was given two trials in Hong Kong. In the latest trial, he sat midfield and finished sixth under pressure, beaten by 5-1/4Ls, over 1200m AWT at Sha Tin on October 22. He’s probably not shaping like a first-up winner and this run will undoubtedly improve him.
formguide.comments_chi: 「比你快」(Outstrip)之後，在港同父馬包括「亞機拉」及「喜悅一生」等駒，生母出自「冠軍風采」(Gloria de Campeao)。來港前在巴西六戰得三勝三位，頭馬包括一場1600米三歲一級賽，上名賽事包括兩場三歲一級賽，途程分別為1600米及2000米。抵港後試閘兩次。最近10月22日出試田泥1200米，早段居中，末段力策下跑第六名，落後頭馬5.25個馬位。應不足以一出即勝，仍需熱身去提升表現。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Fast(+) (4W4W) Bumped out of stalls, dropped out from wide draw, pushed along widest into home straight, ran on well final 300m.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 快步速(+)(4W4W) 自外檔出閘時發生碰撞，其後墮後。入直路時受推策，走最外疊。最後三百米走勢良佳。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (3W2W) Made contact shortly after start, positioned 2 wide, a length or so back, there to turn, hit the front 300M, kept on very well to the line, easily scored.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(3W2W) 起步後不久發生觸碰，落後約一個馬位，走第二疊。直路彎前居相同位置。三百米處取得領先，保持甚佳走勢至終點，從容勝出。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Sat box seat, angled out in the Straight, closed off strongly to score.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 居包廂位置。直路上向外移出。以勁勢衝刺，勝出賽事。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Slow; (1W1W) Bumped shortly after start, raced in midfield on the inside, saved ground on turn, made some progress early in straight, no clear run 250M to 50M, ran on evenly to the line.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 慢步速;(1W1W) 起步後不久被碰撞，居中間位置，走內疊。直路彎走內疊節省腳程。直路初略為追前。二百五十米處至五十米處之間未能望空。末段走勢平穩。

runnerrecords.comments_eng: Pace Good; (2W2W) Checked early after sluggish start, recovered to race in mid-field, short of room between horses early in home straight and had to switch, burst through to lead 75m out and soon on top, won readily.
runnerrecords.comments_chi: 中等步速;(2W2W) 出閘緩慢，早段勒避，其後恢復走勢，居中間位置。直路初在馬匹之間空位不足，須轉換跑線。突圍而出，七十五米處取得領先。瞬即帶離對手，從容勝出。
